 Partner with Technical Services and Design teams to ensure operational functionality in new residential builds and lead pre\-opening readiness from staffing to licensing.

 Manage residential budgets and capital expenditure (CapEx) programs, ensuring high\-value services are delivered while controlling costs to protect owner returns.

 Conduct regular quality audits and property reviews to identify service gaps and drive time\-bound corrective action plans.

 **.**

 Numbers\-fluent with a proven track record in P\&L management, Net Operating Income (NOI) optimization, and long\-term CapEx planning.

 Poised and professional, with a "participative" management style that motivates property\-level leadership teams.

 Project management or real estate asset management certifications are considered a strong advantage.

To lead the end\-to\-end asset management function across portfolio, including residential, retail and commercial assets, ensuring optimal asset performance, revenue maximization and long\-term value creation. The role is responsible for overseeing leasing (residential and commercial), resale strategies and asset optimization initiatives, while aligning with broader development and community positioning strategy. It ensures sustainable income generation, high occupancy levels and superior tenant/customer experience across all managed assets.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




**Asset Performance \& Revenue Optimization** 




 · Own and drive overall AUM performance across residential and commercial portfolios.
 



 · Develop and execute strategies to maximize rental yield, occupancy and asset value.
 



 · Monitor asset\-level financial performance including NOI, leasing spreads and ROI.
 



 · Identify underperforming assets and implement turnaround strategies.
 



 . Grow the AUM portfolio, set growth strategies, acquisition, creating a fund platform and further divestment strategies.
 







**Asset and Leasing Strategy \& Execution (Residential \& Commercial)** 




 · Oversee asset and leasing strategy, value creation, pricing and positioning across all asset classes.
 



 · Ensure strong occupancy levels through effective demand generation and tenant mix optimization.
 



 · Drive residential and commercial leasing strategies to attract high\-quality corporate tenants.
 



 · Monitor leasing pipelines, conversions and renewals.
 







**Property Management** 




 · Tenant Management: This includes marketing vacant units, screening applicants, handling leasing agreements, and managing tenant turnovers.
 



 · Maintenance \& Repairs: Responsible for routine upkeep, emergency repairs, and preventative maintenance to keep the property safe and attractive.
 



 · Financial Management: Involves collecting rent, budgeting, managing operating expenses, and providing financial reports.
 



 · Legal \& Risk Management: Ensures compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, such as landlord\-tenant laws and safety codes.
 



 · Operational Oversight: Supervising on\-site employees and coordinating with contractors
 







**Resale \& Secondary Market Management** 




 · Establish and manage resale strategy for residential and commercial units.
 



 · Monitor secondary market trends and pricing benchmarks.
 



 · Work with brokers and channel partners to drive resale velocity and value appreciation.
 



 · Ensure alignment between primary sales, resale and leasing strategies.
 



  





**Portfolio Strategy \& Asset Lifecycle Management** 




 · Define long\-term asset management strategies aligned with master development vision.
 



 · Oversee asset lifecycle from post\-handover stabilization to maturity.
 



 · Collaborate with Development and Sales teams on product positioning and future pipeline planning.
 



 · Provide input into new developments based on market insights and asset performance data.
 







**Market Intelligence \& Reporting** 




 · Track market trends across leasing, pricing and demand dynamics in the UAE.
 



 · Benchmark asset performance against competitors and industry standards.
 



 · Prepare periodic AUM performance reports, dashboards and strategic insights for leadership.
 



 · Provide data\-driven recommendations to improve portfolio performance.
 







**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 · Collaborate with Sales, Leasing, Development, Retail, Marketing and Finance teams.
 



 · Align leasing and asset strategies with brand positioning and community vision.
 



 · Support marketing campaigns for leasing and resale initiatives.
 



 · Ensure alignment between asset management and long\-term business strategy.
 







**Governance, Risk \& Compliance** 




 · Ensure all leasing and asset management activities comply with regulatory requirements.

**About NeoStats Analytics:** 




  





 NeoStats is a new\-age, Data \& Analytics firm offering contemporary solutions and infinite possibilities. Our mission is to create lasting competitive advantage for our clients by transforming them into world\-class, data\-driven organizations. Established in 2022 to provide End to End Data \& Analytics Services, we are headquartered out of UAE, with bases in India \& UK. Comprising of industry veterans, we enable structural transformations in Analytics powered by our expertise, true partnership, and e2e implementation approach.
 



  





**About the Job:** 




  





 We are seeking a Technical PMO Manager with deep expertise in loyalty platforms and complex system integrations to lead end\-to\-end delivery across banking and partner ecosystems. The role will drive program governance while actively engaging in technical coordination across APIs, middleware, and data flows to ensure seamless execution of loyalty journeys, including accrual, redemption, and partner integrations.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* Program \& Delivery Management
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of loyalty initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives, timelines, and quality standards
* Coordinate multiple workstreams across business, technology, vendors, and external partners
* Establish and manage PMO governance frameworks, including planning, reporting, risk tracking, and dependency management
* Track milestones, deliverables, and ensure adherence to program timelines and budgets Technical Integration Oversight
* Oversee integration across banking systems, loyalty platforms, and partner ecosystems
* Drive alignment on API specifications, middleware architecture, and data exchange frameworks
* Ensure proper management of data flows, reconciliation processes, and system dependencies
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, translating requirements into actionable plans Loyalty Platform Implementation
* Support implementation of loyalty systems, including: o Customer accrual and earning rules o Redemption journeys across channels o Partner onboarding and integration
* Coordinate SIT, UAT, and end\-to\-end testing cycles, ensuring readiness for go\-live
* Ensure customer journeys are smooth, scalable, and fit for purpose Issue Management \& Root Cause Analysis
* Proactively identify, track, and manage risks, issues, and blockers
* Conduct root cause analysis for integration failures and system defects
* Lead cross\-functional teams in issue resolution, ensuring minimal impact on delivery timelines
* Implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues Stakeholder Management
* Engage senior stakeholders across technology, product, operations, and external partners
* Provide clear and structured reporting on program status, risks, and dependencies
* Ensure alignment across all parties and maintain decision\-making transparency Key Requirements Technical \& Functional Expertise
* Strong understanding of: o APIs, microservices, middleware, and system integrations o Data flows between banking systems, loyalty platforms, and third\-party partners
* Hands\-on experience in loyalty platforms or similar ecosystems (e.g., rewards, campaigns, partner marketplaces)
* Familiarity with end\-to\-end customer journeys including earning, redemption, and settlement Delivery Experience
* Proven experience in leading complex, multi\-stream programs in banking, payments, or loyalty domains
* Demonstrated success in managing cross\-functional and vendor\-driven environments
* Experience overseeing testing cycles (SIT/UAT) and go\-live readiness Problem\-Solving \& Analytical



**Skills** 



* Strong capability in root cause analysis and troubleshooting complex integration issues
* Ability to work in high\-pressure environments with multiple dependencies
* Structured and analytical approach to issue resolution and decision\-making Soft Skills
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business language and vice versa
* Highly organized with strong PMO discipline and attention to detail
* Proactive, ownership\-driven mindset



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* Mandatory: Strong technical understanding of system integrations (APIs, middleware, data flows) across bank systems, loyalty platforms, and partners
* Mandatory: Hands\-on experience in loyalty or similar platform implementations and testing, including partner integration and redemption journeys
* Mandatory: Proven ability to lead end\-to\-end delivery and coordinate multiple workstreams and cross\-functional teams
* Relevant: 8\+ experience in technical program management support with specific experience in launching loyalty platforms/programs
* Preferred: Experience working with banks in KSA/GCC or similar regulated environments
* Preferred: Exposure to loyalty vendors / platforms
* Preferred: Certifications in PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum are a plus



  





**What we offer:** 




  




* Competitive Salary and Benefits
* Opportunity to be part of a fast\-paced and growing startup. Grow your career with the company.
* Ownership – You will own your initiative and be given specific responsibilities.
* Continuous coaching \& mentoring – You will have the opportunity to interact and work closely with other senior data scientists and AI experts across the globe.
* Dynamic and respectful work environment – we truly value you.

data.jd_text:
Who We Are
   

  

 At Inverto in Riyadh, we’re defining what’s next in procurement and supply chain—driven by ambition, precision, and impact. With the strength of BCG behind us and a sharp entrepreneurial mindset at our core, we partner with leading global organizations to deliver strategies that create lasting value.
   

  

 Our people are central to that mission. As experts who move with intent and momentum, we continually invest in developing our capabilities, expanding our reach, and scaling our impact. Growth at Inverto is shared growth\-opening new opportunities for our clients, our business, and our teams.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The Business \& Operations Senior Manager drives the effective operationalization of Inverto’s regional growth agenda by leading key commercial, people, financial, and operational processes for the Middle East.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic partner to Inverto leadership and EMESA teams, the role ensures transparency in business development activities, enables strong go\-to\-market execution, and supports high\-quality decision\-making through robust performance and financial management. It plays a central role in shaping and sustaining talent and team development, driving a cohesive and high\-performing culture, and ensuring optimal staffing and resource allocation.
   

  

 The position also safeguards operational excellence by strengthening cross\-functional collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA, ensuring reliable data flow, and securing compliance with governance, legal, and internal standards. Additionally, it oversees local office operations and orchestrates shared services and marketing initiatives to enable seamless delivery and reinforce Inverto’s brand presence in the region.
   

  

 A key aspect of the role is ensuring alignment between BCG core and Inverto\-specific requirements, in accordance with Inverto’s global guardrails, and business model.
   

  

 Overall, the role is critical in enabling the Middle East business to operate effectively, grow sustainably, and achieve its strategic objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Management and GTM support
* Partner with Inverto Managing Directors, Principals, and Inverto EMESA to operationalize the Inverto growth plan and operating model by translating strategic priorities into actionable initiatives and effective execution
* Liaise with the Inverto Business Excellence team and local Inverto leadership to ensure full transparency in the BD pipeline, including tool management / data accuracy, process alignment, and effective governance of local Inverto leads
* Enable commercial success by creating visibility into local platforms (e.g., local BCG lead calls), synthesizing insights, and supporting senior stakeholders with actionable steering information
* People \& Talent Management
* Drive optimal team deployment and resource allocation in close collaboration with the Inverto EMESA team, ensuring sustained delivery capacity and alignment with business needs
* Shape the Middle East hiring strategy jointly with Inverto EMESA and local recruiting teams, contributing to the attraction and retention of top consulting talent and enhancing the effectiveness of selection processes
* Coordinate and improve professional development initiatives \- including career development, training, retention, and team affiliation \- liaising with EMESA team
* Lead local people\-related initiatives that strengthen team cohesion and organizational culture
* Ensure smooth HR operations and benefits implementation in collaboration with local HR teams
* Support driving the Teaming process in partnership with Inverto’s central Teaming Team, ensuring effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Financial Planning \& Performance Management
* Collaborate with Finance teams to steer annual strategic and financial planning processes, ensuring alignment between functional priorities and financial targets
* Ensure rigorous budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting, translating data into insights and recommendations for senior leadership
* Liaise with Inverto and BCG Finance teams to ensure accurate cost accounting and P\&L management against Plan
* Support Inverto Commercial Finance in maintaining full transparency of the project portfolio, enabling informed decision\-making on performance and risk management
* Collaboration \& Data flow
* Maintain strong and effective collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA teams (BST, HR, IT, etc.), enhancing cross\-functional processes and ensuring smooth operational integration
* Ensure reliable information and data flow between Inverto Middle East and Inverto EMESA, including oversight of non\-automated processes and adherence to data governance standards
* Risk Management \& Compliance Coordination
* Support governance, risk management, and compliance efforts by ensuring alignment of local operations with Inverto EMESA and BCG Core requirements, while proactively identifying improvement areas
* Ensure compliance with legal standards and internal policies, implementing effective local controls and maintaining transparency on regulatory updates
* Establish processes to systematically gather and synthesize up\-to\-date information on relevant compliance regulations
* Local Coordination \& Office Enablement
* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations of the Inverto team and act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth and efficient business operations
* Coordinate shared services and functions (e.g., HR, Recruiting, IT) with BCG where applicable, optimizing processes to support local delivery
* Drive local marketing initiatives and ensure consistent execution of campaigns in alignment with global teams (Global Inverto Marketing and Global Employer Branding), maintaining a unified and compelling brand presence


 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Bachelors or Masters degree with an above\-average grade.
   

  

 8\+ years of relevant experience within business operations
   

  

 Confident presence in an international environment, business fluent in English.
   

  

 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 Reporting to the Inverto Managing Director
   

  

 Working with global, regional and local teams
   

  

 Hyper motivated individuals
   

  

 Entrepreneurs and those that have a growth mindset
   

  

 Teammates that are authentic by nature, they thrive to support the team to win
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 BCG is an E \- Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E\-Verify.

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Project Director to lead high end project in a remote site in KSA. This role will oversee design reviews, programme \& project management and site supervision across a complex, multi\-package programme involving mixed use assets.
   

  

 You will act as the single point of contact between internal and external delivery teams, ensuring strategic alignment, stakeholder coordination, and successful delivery of project objectives. The successful candidate will bring delivery experience to the programme.
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Sector Experience**
* Proven track record in delivering high end projects.
* Experience in multidisciplinary design review, programme management, and site supervision.
* Demonstrated leadership in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments.


**Strategic Leadership \& Programme Oversight**
* Provide strategic leadership across the full programme lifecycle—from concept development and mobilisation through to delivery, commissioning, and benefits realization.
* Align project delivery with client goals, regulatory frameworks, and KSA development strategies.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams across design, engineering, construction, and stakeholder engagement.
* Represent AtkinsRéalis on client boards and steering committees to ensure strategic alignment and
* confidence in programme delivery.


**Planning \& Scheduling**
* Implement a robust project management framework and execution strategy.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of the master programme and WBS.
* Lead delay mitigation strategies and ensure alignment with critical path milestones.
* Monitor contract programmes and ensure stakeholder approvals are timely and compliant.


**Financial \& Commercial Management**
* Own and manage programme\-level P\&L, ensuring financial performance, cost control, and commercial success.
* Review and report project budgets, recommend options for potential changes.
* Oversee contract administration, change control, and claims resolution.
* Coordinate with commercial teams to ensure transparency and governance throughout the project.


**Risk Management \& Governance**
* Chair risk meetings and lead the development of mitigation strategies.
* Ensure robust governance, risk management, and change control processes are in place and adhered to.
* Collaborate with commercial teams to manage disputes and claims proactively.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as the primary liaison with the client, government authorities, consultants, and contractors.
* Lead external stakeholder management and interface coordination, including IDD documentation.
* Resolve escalated issues and maintain strong relationships with all project parties.


**Innovation \& Digital Transformation**
* Champion innovation and digital transformation across programme delivery, including BIM, smart mobility, and integrated systems.
* Promote modern delivery methodologies to drive efficiency and enhance outcomes.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Mentor senior leadership team and technical leads.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct performance reviews and support career development across the team.


**Reporting \& Governance**
* Establish formal reporting structures for client and internal stakeholders.
* Review and disseminate reports from design and site teams.


**Client Management**
* Lead client engagement through presentations, meetings, and strategic discussions.
* Represent AtkinsRéalis professionally and build trust as a strategic advisor.
* Resolve disputes and maintain long\-term client relationships.


**Industry Engagement \& Thought Leadership**
* Represent AtkinsRéalis in strategic forums, bid interviews, and industry engagements.
* Contribute to thought leadership and market positioning in the regional buildings \& places sector.


**About You**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field (Master'S or preferred Chartered Engineer status).
* Minimum 20 years of experience in project leadership.
* Strong knowledge of construction, planning, contract law, and stakeholder management.


 Rewards \& benefits
   

  

 Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Tax\-free salary.
* Life insurance coverage.
* Medical insurance.
* Annual leave balance.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Annual flight contribution.
* Transportation \& housing allowances.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.


 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
   

  

**About AtkinsRéalis**
 We're AtkinsRéalis, a world\-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
   

  

 Find out more.

Do you want to love what you do at work? Do you want to make a difference, an impact, transform peoples lives? Do you want to work with a team that believes in disrupting the normal, boring, and average?
   

  

 If yes, then this is the job you're looking for ,webook.com is Saudi's \#1 event ticketing and experience booking platforms in terms of technology, features, agility, revenue serving some of the largest mega events in the Kingdom surpassing over 2 billion sales.
   

  

**Role Overview :**
 webook.com is looking for a Director of Strategy to establish and lead the company's Strategy Management Office (SMO). Reporting directly to the Chief Strategy Officer, this role will work closely with executive leadership and key stakeholders across the business.
   

  

 This position is suited for someone who enjoys building functions from the ground up, creating structure in fast\-moving environments, and driving strategic initiatives from concept through execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy Management Office**
* Establish and lead the SMO, including governance models, planning processes, OKR structures, KPI reporting, and executive dashboards
* Coordinate quarterly business reviews and strategic planning cycles
* Track execution of company\-wide strategic initiatives and ensure accountability across departments
* Develop reporting frameworks for executive leadership and board visibility


**Corporate Strategy \& Expansion**
* Support the development and execution of corporate strategy across existing and future markets
* Build market assessment and expansion frameworks for international growth opportunities
* Lead cross\-functional strategic initiatives and monitor delivery against targets


**Investments \& Strategic Partnerships**
* Partner with the investments team on evaluating acquisitions, partnerships, and venture opportunities
* Support commercial and strategic due diligence processes
* Assist with integration planning and post\-deal execution where required
* Develop frameworks for assessing strategic fit and long\-term value creation


**Executive \& Board Engagement**
* Prepare board materials, strategic presentations, and investor\-facing narratives
* Support communication with institutional shareholders and strategic stakeholders
* Provide strategic analysis and recommendations to senior leadership


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Lead and develop members of the strategy team
* Strengthen internal capabilities across strategic planning, execution management, and analytical problem\-solving
* Foster a high\-performance and ownership\-driven culture within the function


**Requirements**
* 8\-12 years of experience in strategy, corporate development, transformation, or a related field
* Experience building or leading a Strategy Management Office or similar strategic execution function
* Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from strategy through implementation and measurable business outcomes
* Background within high\-growth, scale\-up, PE\-backed, VC\-backed, or pre\-IPO environments
* Exposure to M\&A, partnerships, investment evaluation, or market expansion initiatives
* Experience preparing and presenting materials for senior executives or boards
* Fluent in both Arabic and English


**Preferred Background**
* Experience in live events, entertainment, sports, marketplaces, or consumer technology
* Familiarity with the Saudi and broader MENA business landscape
* Exposure to international expansion across multiple markets


**Why Join webook.com**
* Opportunity to shape strategy at one of the region's most prominent growth\-stage companies
* Direct exposure to executive leadership, institutional shareholders, and board\-level decision\-making
* Ability to build and define a strategic function from the ground up
* Fast\-paced environment with significant regional and international growth ambitions


**This Role May Not Be Suitable For**
* Candidates whose experience is primarily advisory or consulting\-based without operational ownership
* Individuals who have supported strategy functions but not directly led execution
* Candidates who rely heavily on established structures and processes rather than building them
* Limited exposure to executive stakeholder management

**Description**
**Job Purpose:**
 To manage the overall complete company financial and operational performance of the respective areas of responsibility as per the guidelines given by Chief Executive Officer. To ensure strict adherence to the scope of work detailed in the terms and conditions of the contract under the individual’s management. Ensure that strict cost control systems are established in all departments in the operation, and that they are constantly maintained and monitored. To ensure that storage and stock control systems are maintained up to date, and to monitor stock rotation and validity. To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
* To ensure that the contract is operated within the budgetary margins established for the operation.
* To maintain constant liaison with the Client representative for the individual’s operation and establish a good working relationship.
* To monitor ordering of all supplies/requirements both internally on site and from the supplier.
* To ensure that validity of all employee documentation, e.g. security passes, medical certificates, licenses, vacations where applicable, are maintained and that timely action is taken for renewal that will not adversely affect the individual’s operation.
* To ensure employee time sheets are correctly filled in and that they are forwarded to Head Office on time each month.
* To liaise with Training Department for Staff Trainings.
* To conduct job training on the individual’s operations.
* To carry out annual evaluations of staff. Make recommendations for employee promotions, salary changes, employee of the month, disciplinary action, including termination where applicable.
* To ensure that employees are aware of the company policies and procedures and to ensure compliance.
* To ensure that the individual is aware of the contents of the KSA labor Law, and its stipulations regarding disciplinary action in particular.
* To ensure that leave schedules are maintained, and that requests for relievers are submitted to CEO at least two months in advance.
* To ensure strict confidentiality of all company financial information regardless of its nature.
* To compile and submit to CEO monthly reports on all aspects of the operations that should highlight any problems encountered and actions taken to rectify them.
* This report should cover maintenance activities, including both planned and reactive tasks, which are completed within required timeframes, on\-going or new projects information, supplier communications and enhancement schemes for the cost\-effective management of services.
* To ensure that copies of all Client correspondence, minutes of site meetings and any other communication (verbal or written) pertained to the operation are transmitted to the CEO immediately upon acknowledgment.
* The CEO must review on all offers to the Client prior to submittal. Site Engineers, where applicable, must be involved in offers pertaining to anything within the individual’s discipline.
* To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled. CEO must be informed of any major R\&M activity.
* To ensure that highest standards of health, hygiene and safety are maintained in the individual’s operation and to liaise closely with the company’s CEO on these matters.
* Closely monitor the performance of all the department heads.
* Adhere to the safety regulations set by the company as well as the Client.
* Provide on monthly basis with a safety statistic report for the individual’s entire operation.
* Liaise with the Client on all matters related to Safety.
* Conduct safety meetings with all the department heads and establish a safety committee to closely monitor and update management on safety matters.
* To perform any other duties requested by the CEO out of the normal routine but within the scope of work.
* The individual is fully responsible and accountable for the HSE policies and procedures, which are in place.
* To conform to the Company’s guidelines related to the area as detailed in the Company’s Quality Assurance Program developed on the basis of ISO 9001:2000 Q.M. S


**All Fakeeh Care employees are responsible for continuous improvement, including:**
* Performing all duties and tasks in a manner that supports Fakeeh’s Person\-Centered care values.
* Actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, within the scope of the role.
* Adherence to safety protocols and proactively seeking to address any job\-related safety concerns.
* Maintaining strict confidentiality of all sensitive information accessed or encountered during work.
* Complying with cybersecurity policies and standards to protect Fakeeh’s systems and participating in awareness training and initiatives to prevent cyber threats.
* Adhering to and upholding Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies and ethical standards.
* Completion of mandatory education as per the requirement, at least one month prior to expiration.


**Requirements**
* Minimum 10 years operational experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Experience in facility management and healthcare environments from a well reputed local or international companies.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA from an accredited University.
* Excellent command of oral and written English and Arabic.

**Build the Future of Rail in the Middle East with Mace**
 As we expand our rail capability across the Middle East, Mace is seeking exceptional talent to help shape and deliver some of the region’s most ambitious transport programmes.
   

  

 With a globally recognised track record across high‑speed rail, conventional rail, metro, and complex station environments, we are now growing our presence in the region — and building a high‑calibre talent pool to support this next phase.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Experienced Professionals Across**
* Project and Programme Management
* Cost and Commercial Management
* Project Controls and Planning


**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Directs the coordination and delivery of programmes, aligning project execution with defined strategic objectives, vision, and outcomes.
* Establishes and maintains an effective programme delivery environment across people, organisational structure, processes, information, and technology.
* Drives performance improvement beyond baseline targets through optimisation of resources and continuous monitoring, evaluation, and refinement of systems and methodologies.
* Leads governance of safety, quality, cost, schedule, risk, sustainability, compliance, and stakeholder management to ensure consistent delivery excellence.
* Maintains comprehensive programme documentation, including plans, procedures, reports, registers, and lessons learned to support informed decision\-making.
* Builds and leads high\-performing, inclusive teams, fostering collaboration, engagement, and a culture of service excellence and continuous improvement.
* Manages key internal and external stakeholder relationships, strengthening communication, engagement, and long\-term network development.

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Enterprise clients don't churn because of the product. They churn because implementation fails, adoption stalls, or they never get to the outcome they were sold.
   

  

 As Lucidya moves upmarket \- BFSI, telecom, media, retail \- the complexity of deployments grows. Onboarding a large enterprise is no longer a handoff. It's a multi\-month, multi\-stakeholder programme with real financial and reputational stakes on both sides.
   

  

 This role owns that entire delivery motion. You will build and lead the team responsible for getting customers from signed contracts to measurable value \- and keeping them there. You will own the managed services P\&L and the operational rigour that separates a world\-class implementation function from a reactive project management team.
   

  

 If you are energised by building structure in complexity, are equally comfortable in a client boardroom and a resource planning spreadsheet, and want your work to directly determine whether enterprise customers succeed \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Lead delivery end\-to\-end.**
* Execute the PMO strategy across customer onboarding, implementation, migration, and ongoing managed services \- translating strategic direction into reliable, repeatable delivery
* Ensure every project is delivered within scope, on time, and within budget \- and that CSAT and NPS reflect it
* Serve as the executive escalation point when projects hit risk. You do not wait to be told \- you see it coming
* Develop, enforce, and continuously improve standardised delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid depending on the engagement)


**Own the commercial side of services.**
* Own the deal economics for managed services \- project profitability, gross margins, and commercial accountability for the delivery function
* Forecast team capacity, manage utilisation, and optimise staffing across implementation specialists, project managers, analysts, and designers to match pipeline demand
* Work with Sales to scope SOWs accurately. Overpromising at the deal stage is a delivery problem \- you have a say in preventing it


**Build and develop the team.**
* Lead a team of Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and Programme Managers
* Mentor the team on advanced client management, negotiation, risk mitigation, and how to balance client customisation requests against platform scalability
* Build a culture of product stewardship \- the team should be Lucidya's strongest advocates for what the platform does well, not just executors of client requests


**Be the bridge between clients and the business.**
* Manage expectations on custom development by bridging communication between clients and Engineering and Product teams \- clearly, without overpromising
* Report project health, velocity, and risk to executive leadership in a way that enables fast decisions
* Partner with clients on internal capability building \- recruitment of client\-side resources, upskilling programmes, and adoption ramp plans that increase their self\-sufficiency over time
* Drive continuous improvement. Every delivery cycle should produce lessons that shorten the next one


 You are responsible for outcomes: delivery quality, margin, client satisfaction, and a team that gets better every quarter.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 7\-10\+ years of professional experience, with at least 3\-5 years leading project or delivery teams inside a SaaS environment
* You have run complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise implementations \- and you have the scars to prove it
* You are as comfortable in a C\-suite escalation conversation as you are in a weekly project status call. You know how to communicate risk without creating panic
* You understand the commercial side of services. Margin, utilisation rates, and SOW scope are not someone else's problem
* You do not manage by spreadsheet alone. You understand what motivates delivery teams and how to build a culture that takes ownership of client outcomes
* You have a working knowledge of SaaS architecture, APIs, and cloud\-based implementations \- enough to have credible technical conversations with clients and product teams
* You hold or have held a PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification. You apply methodology pragmatically, not dogmatically
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where process is still being built. You improve the system while running it


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but adaptable
* Client\-obsessed but commercially grounded
* A builder, not just a manager
* Calm under pressure \- and you set that tone for your team


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the CRO
* Case study presentation \- delivery scenario and P\&L walk\-through
* Offer

**Overview**
 AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Commercial Director to lead the commercial strategy and delivery oversight for complex projects in KSA. This role will be responsible for managing contracts, procurement, cost control, and commercial risk across multiple Design \& Build packages, including civil works, stations, systems, depots, rolling stock, and track.

**Strategic Commercial Leadership**
* Define and implement commercial strategies aligned with programme objectives, market conditions, and client expectations.
* Lead commercial input into procurement planning, contract structuring, and delivery models.
* Ensure commercial alignment across all packages and disciplines.


**Contract \& Claims Management**
* Lead negotiation, administration, and resolution of contracts, ensuring compliance with legal frameworks and client requirements.
* Oversee preparation and management of contract documentation, including Letters of Acceptance (LOA), change control notices, and claims analysis.
* Monitor contract performance and implement mitigation strategies for commercial risks.


**Cost Management \& Forecasting**
* Oversee cost planning, budgeting, and forecasting across all workstreams.
* Ensure adherence to cost management guidelines and promote best practices across the procurement lifecycle.

* Review and validate contractor pay applications and ensure timely approvals.


**Risk \& Performance Monitoring**
* Identify and manage commercial risks across the project lifecycle.
* Maintain change management logs and ensure commercial reporting is accurate and timely.
* Establish and maintain consistent commercial procedures across all project teams.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Act as the senior commercial point of contact for clients, consultants, and contractors.
* Ensure transparency and trust in all commercial dealings and foster long\-term relationships.
* Coordinate with construction and project managers to resolve commercial and contractual issues.


**Team Leadership \& Development**

* Ensure high professional standards, accuracy, and accountability across the commercial function.

data.jd_text:
**Gold And Minerals Joint Stock Company**
 Gold and Minerals is a leading exploration and development company specializing in gold and base metal projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. With a strong focus on sustainable and responsible mining practices, the company is committed to unlocking the Kingdom’s rich mineral potential while contributing to its economic growth.
   

  

 The company has a proven track record in discovering and developing high\-quality mineral resources, highlighted by the success of its flagship
 **Jabal Qutman Gold** 
 ,
 **Wadi Bidah Copper\-Gold and Ajlan JV** 
 projects, positioning it as one of the key players in Saudi Arabia’s growing mining sector. In response to the Kingdom’s strategic initiatives to expand the mining industry, Gold and Minerals is actively expanding its team to support its ambitious exploration and development programs.
   

  

 Our team consists of highly skilled, multinational geologists and mining professionals working collaboratively across resource expansion, project development, and greenfield exploration projects. We foster a dynamic, innovative, and safety\-focused work environment that encourages professional growth, knowledge sharing, and career advancement.
   

  

 At Gold and Minerals , we are passionate about creating value for our stakeholders while maintaining the highest standards of environmental stewardship and community engagement.
   

  

 Joining our team means being part of a forward\-thinking organization that is shaping the future of mining in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Responsible for providing strategic leadership, direction, and oversight of the newly formed joint venture. Ensures execution of shareholders’ joint exploration, resource definition, project development, and assessment through to mining strategy and operational mine site. Drives value creation by ensuring safe business operations, efficient implementation, innovation, team development, adherence to timelines, and reporting requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver the JV’s work program as committed to MIM.
* Develop and execute work programs aligned with project requirements and exploration results to meet timelines.
* Manage operational functions and ensure delivery of approved plans.
* Assess and optimize future mining projects.
* Ensure safe operations across exploration, project definition, construction, and mining activities.
* Manage costs within approved budgets.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting to shareholders and MIM.
* Maintain strong governance standards, including procurement compliance.
* Lead and develop high\-performing leadership teams and promote a strong safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with legal, environmental, and regulatory requirements, including mining license applications.
* Represent both shareholders’ interests within the joint venture.
* Ensure effective engagement with local communities and stakeholders.


**Key Work Interactions**
 Internal Relationships
   

  

* Joint Venture Technical Committee
* Shareholders
* Employees
* Site General Managers and Operations
* Shareholder financial teams


 External Relationships
   

  

* Communities
* Government agencies and regulatory bodies
* Consultants and engineering firms
* Equipment and technology suppliers
* Adjacent license holders
* Contractors and service providers


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Mineral Processing, or related field
* Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Health \& Safety certification is desirable
* Valid driving licence in KSA or convertible to KSA licence


**Experience**
* Minimum 15 years of experience in the mining industry, with at least 10 years in senior leadership roles
* Proven track record in managing advanced exploration projects and delivering feasibility studies
* Experience in coordinating multidisciplinary teams and transitioning projects from exploration to development and operations
* Experience in establishing new projects, including policy development, training, and HSE procedures
* Strong understanding of structurally controlled gold deposits, open pit mining, and precious metal processing
* Culturally adept and delivery\-focused
* Strong leadership, strategic thinking, and communication skills


**Work Schedule**
 This role operates on a FIFO roster in a remote operational location, following a 6 weeks on / 3 weeks off rotation schedule.

As the global leader in high\-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people\-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well\-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.
   

  

**Senior Service Project Manager – Services Delivery (MEA)**
 This role plays a critical part in delivering Ciena Services outcomes for customers across the Middle East and Africa. The position leads complex service delivery engagements end to end, balancing customer commitments, operational execution, and financial performance. Success in this role directly impacts customer experience, service margin, and long\-term customer trust in Ciena.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex customer service projects across the MEA region, ensuring alignment to agreed scope, schedule, and financial targets
* Act as the primary service delivery interface for customers, partners, and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle
* Drive project planning, execution tracking, risk management, and issue resolution across multi\-disciplinary delivery teams
* Establish and run regular project governance and customer review forums to provide visibility into progress, risks, and mitigation actions
* Monitor and control delivery performance against scope, budget expectations, resource utilization, and service margins
* Contribute to presales and early engagement activities by providing delivery input, effort estimation, and risk assessment
* Promote consistent, high\-quality service delivery outcomes through clear communication, structured execution, and accountability


**The Must Haves**
* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in Service Delivery, Project Management, or Service Coordination roles
* Background in managing customer\-facing delivery engagements involving cross\-functional engineering and services teams
* Application of project management practices including scope definition, milestone planning, risk management, and status reporting
* Exposure to financial and commercial aspects of service delivery, including margin awareness, cost drivers, and revenue recognition alignment
* Background working with network lifecycle activities such as design, deployment, migration, and validation
* Application of delivery practices within optical transport and networking environments, including DWDM and Layer 0/Layer 1 technologies
* Ability to operate as a central coordination point across sales, bid management, service delivery, engineering, finance, partners, and customer operations teams
* Capability to work autonomously in a fully remote model while collaborating daily with geographically distributed teams
* Ability to work across time zones and cultures with a high level of accountability and self\-management


**Nice To Haves**
* Experience operating in early\-stage or loosely defined delivery environments
* Background balancing technical discussions with delivery planning and commercial considerations
* Demonstrated ability to drive delivery teams through complexity and ambiguity
* Exposure to large\-volume or multi\-project delivery environments
* Experience working within a matrix organizational structure
* Application of customer\-facing communication in executive or stakeholder forums
* Utilization of standard project management tools for planning, tracking, and reporting


 At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.
   

  

 Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.
   

  

 If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

data.jd_text:
Our subsidiary Jadaya is seeking for a Program Management \- Assistant Manager to oversee multiple projects and ensure alignment with the organization's strategic objectives. The role is responsible for delivering programs on time, within scope, and within budget while driving operational efficiency, stakeholder alignment, and overall program success.
   

  

 The Program Management Assistant Manager will coordinate resources, lead and mentor project teams, monitor risks and performance metrics, and facilitate communication across stakeholders to ensure successful program outcomes
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Develop and define program plans, objectives, scope, and deliverables while ensuring alignment with organizational goals
* Communicate with stakeholders to gain support for program success
* Work closely with Project Managers to develop project schedules, budgets, and resource allocation plans
* Execute governance and gate checks throughout the program lifecycle
* Oversee the execution of multiple related projects, ensuring delivery on time, within budget, and according to quality standards
* Efficiently allocate resources across projects and manage interdependencies to optimize workflow and performance
* Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, facilitating communication and managing expectations throughout the program lifecycle
* Ensure stakeholder engagement and communication plans are maintained effectively
* Identify potential risks and issues, develop mitigation strategies, and implement corrective actions to minimize project impact
* Track program performance metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs), providing regular updates to senior management and stakeholders
* Monitor and report project status, identifying variances from the plan and recommending corrective actions
* Support the development and analysis of project forecasts and budget allocation exercises
* Advocate for project management best practices and drive continuous improvement initiatives within the PMO
* Mentor and develop Project Managers and team members, fostering a culture of collaboration and accountability
* Prepare and present program status reports, highlighting achievements, challenges, risks, and recommendations
* Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to the Project Coordinator


**Requirements**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* Master's degree is preferred


**Certifications**
* Professional certifications in Project and Program Management such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certifications are mandatory


**Experience**
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in Project and Program Management
* Proven experience managing multiple projects and/or program portfolios
* Strong track record of strategic alignment, stakeholder management, and successful project delivery


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills
* Ability to manage multiple programs and projects simultaneously
* Flexibility to adapt to changing project requirements and environments
* Leadership and mentoring capabilities for cross\-functional teams
* Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making skills
* Excellent negotiation and conflict\-resolution abilities
* Advanced communication and stakeholder management skills
* Strong problem\-solving and risk management capabilities
* Financial acumen and reporting skills
* Team collaboration and adaptability

**Who We Are**
 At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology\-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end\-to\-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line\-haul transportation, last\-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross\-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.
   

  

**Our Global Reach**
 JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross\-border movement. Today, we operate 130\+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.
   

  

 Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people\-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast\-evolving industry.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high\-quality results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Project Lifecycle Management: This includes project initiation, making project plans, detailing project work content, adjusting project plans according to the actual situation, and coordinating with project stakeholders to complete the work, ensuring high\-quality project delivery . 2\. On\-site Project Implementation Management, coordinating resources from all parties to ensure that the civil construction renovation, power and communication system, installation and commissioning of logistics automation equipment, and other tasks are carried out in an orderly manner, proceed as planned, and are delivered on time. 3\. Project Delivery and Integration: Collaborating with planning, operations, R\&D, equipment supplier, and other parties, organizing project training, on\-site setup, warehouse relocation, and starting operation to ensure a smooth project launch.
* Accumulation of Project Implementation Techniques and Standardization Construction: Based on the practice of Middle East project construction and operation, accumulate and compile Middle East project construction standards from the principles of compliance, efficiency, and economy, continuously iterate and improve to enhance the efficiency and quality of project construction.


 ﻿
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree or above, majors in Industrial Engineering, Logistics and supply chain management, Automation, and other related fields.
* Language Requirement: Fluent in English, capable of using it as a working language for meetings, reports, and project communication.
* Work Experience: More than 3 years of experience in project implementation, familiar with the overseas working environment and logistics policies, with experience in managing automated projects such as large\-scale warehousing centers, sorting centers, etc. Priority will be given to those with overseas project implementation experience.
* Basic Skills: Rigorous logical thinking and data sensitivity, good summarization and induction abilities, and data analysis capabilities. Proficient in at least one data analysis tool, such as EXCEL, SQL, Python, etc.
* Soft Skills: Possess strong project management and cross\-departmental coordination abilities, able to adapt to periodic business trips within the Middle East region. Have a structured thinking process, good at summarizing and extracting, and capable of distilling methodologies from projects.


*At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*
**Ready to apply?**
 Take the next step in your career, apply now and explore the opportunities we have to offer.

data.jd_text:
Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia's future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture — a 360 km² mega\-project just outside Riyadh. From F1\-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums and performance venues, we're creating a destination like no other. This is more than a project — it's a national transformation. As construction accelerates, we're hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you're driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up — Qiddiya is calling
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Lead the planning and execution of all event operations and site\-wide delivery at Cultural and Heritage program, ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality delivery of cultural programming, guest experience, and large\-scale event operations in alignment with asset objectives
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Event Operations Planning \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of all event operations across Cultural and Heritage program, including the Festival and year\-round programming
* Translate programming, marketing, and commercial plans into detailed operational delivery models
* Develop and manage event operations plans, schedules, and resource requirements
* Ensure seamless execution of all programming and activities in line with operational plans


**Logistics, Site Readiness \& Overlay**
* Lead planning and execution of logistics, site readiness, and event overlay (temporary infrastructure, structures, utilities, and services)
* Ensure readiness of all operational infrastructure prior to opening and across event cycles
* Oversee site setup, dismantling, and transition between events or programming phases
* Coordinate movement planning including access, transport, parking, and crowd flows


**Health, Safety \& Security (HSE)**
* Establish and enforce HSE and security frameworks across all operations
* Oversee crowd management planning, emergency response, and incident management protocols
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and authority requirements
* Coordinate with security agencies and government entities to ensure safe delivery


**Guest Experience \& On\-Ground Delivery**
* Ensure delivery of a high\-quality, safe, and seamless visitor experience across all touchpoints
* Oversee guest flow, queue management, accessibility, and service standards
* Monitor on\-ground performance and address operational issues in real time


**Vendor \& Operator Management**
* Oversee management of all operational vendors, contractors, and service providers
* Ensure vendor performance meets operational, safety, and service standards
* Coordinate with procurement and contract management functions


**Cross\-Functional Integration \& Feasibility**
* Lead operational feasibility assessment of programming, commercial, and marketing initiatives
* Ensure alignment between programming requirements and operational capabilities
* Work closely with:
+ Programming → feasibility and scheduling
+ Commercial → activation requirements
+ Marketing → campaign\-driven demand


**Asset \& Site Coordination**
* Coordinate closely with Asset \& Site Management on facilities, maintenance, and infrastructure readiness
* Ensure operational alignment with permanent and temporary asset requirements
* Support long\-term planning of site usage and capacity


**Asset Management \& Group Alignment**
* Align operational plans with Asset Management direction and performance expectations
* Coordinate with Qiddiya Group functions and external authorities where required
* Provide operational input into planning, budgeting, and performance reviews


**Performance Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track operational KPIs including service levels, efficiency, and safety

 As we expand our rail capability across the Middle East, Mace is seeking exceptional talent to help shape and deliver some of the region’s most ambitious transport programmes.
   

  

 With a globally recognised track record across high‑speed rail, conventional rail, metro, and complex station environments, we are now growing our presence in the region — and building a high‑calibre talent pool to support this next phase.

* Project and Programme Management
* Cost and Commercial Management
* Project Controls and Planning


**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Determines and coordinates project management, technical services, and external resources required to deliver projects effectively on behalf of the client.

**About You**
 You will bring proven experience in major rail or infrastructure programmes, coupled with the ability to operate in complex, fast‑paced delivery environments.  If you are motivated by delivering complex programmes, working with high‑performing teams, and contributing to the development of world‑class infrastructure, we would welcome the opportunity to connect.
   

  

 Join us in delivering the next generation of rail across the Middle East.

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya comple
data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 At Lucidya, closing a deal is the beginning of the work \- not the end of it. Enterprise clients come with complex requirements, multiple stakeholders, and zero tolerance for delivery that doesn't match what was promised.
   

  

 This role sits at the centre of that delivery. You will be the operational backbone that keeps projects on track, stakeholders aligned, and risks visible before they become problems. You will work across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal \- not as a coordinator, but as the person who holds the whole picture and makes sure every part of the business is moving in the same direction.
   

  

 If you are the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when things are vague, who builds structure because it actually helps, and who takes personal ownership of whether a project lands well \- this role is for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Own delivery from pre\-RFP to go\-live.**
* Lead pre\-RFP alignment sessions to validate scope, timeline, resource availability, and budget assumptions before any commitment is made
* Establish and enforce a handover framework from RFP to delivery \- with clear ownership and traceability at every stage of the project lifecycle
* Ensure every project proposal goes through cross\-functional validation (Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance) before it goes out the door
* Review vendor and subcontractor arrangements for procurement compliance and operational readiness


**Run governance like it matters \- because it does.**
* Design and maintain project governance frameworks that define accountability, escalation paths, and decision\-making checkpoints
* Keep a live project and risk register covering progress, dependencies, financial exposure, and compliance risks
* Maintain executive dashboards and PMO reports that give leadership real visibility \- not a sanitised summary
* Enforce stage gates and approval processes before any contractual, financial, or delivery commitment is made
* Run post\-implementation reviews that actually produce lessons, not just documentation


**Keep every part of the business aligned.**
* Serve as the central coordination point across Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Finance, Legal, and Delivery
* Lead project initiation, steering, and review meetings \- and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates
* Maintain consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders through dashboards, executive summaries, and progress reports that people actually read
* Facilitate procurement and vendor coordination, ensuring external partners meet internal standards and regulatory requirements


**Manage third\-party and vendor risk.**
* Oversee vendor and third\-party onboarding governance \- tools, processors, and contractors must meet data protection and regulatory standards before they touch a project
* Maintain a Third\-Party Risk Register tracking compliance obligations, privacy safeguards, and mitigation activities
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Data Privacy on risk assessments, incident responses, and breach reporting related to external partners


**Bring the same rigour to internal programmes.**
* Extend the PM framework beyond client projects to internal strategic initiatives \- process transformation, system rollouts, product programmes
* Track progress against annual strategic objectives and KPIs, and report it clearly to leadership
* Develop and maintain standardised PM tools, templates, and procedures that the wider team can actually use


 You are responsible for outcomes: projects that land on time, within budget, and without surprises.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 5\+ years in project or programme management, preferably in SaaS or enterprise technology. You have managed complex, multi\-workstream projects and you know what good governance looks like in practice
* You are comfortable holding multiple complex projects simultaneously without dropping the thread on any of them
* You think in terms of risk before others see it. You flag early, escalate when you should, and never let a problem fester because it was uncomfortable to raise
* You have real financial acumen \- cost modelling, budget tracking, and ROI analysis are not tasks you hand off
* You can influence without authority. You work across functions where you do not control the resources, and you still get things done
* Your communication is clear, structured, and calibrated to the audience \- whether that is an engineer, a client, or a CEO
* You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification. You apply methodology pragmatically \- the framework serves the project, not the other way around
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where not everything is defined. You build the structure and improve it as you go


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but not rigid
* Proactive, not reactive
* Calm when it gets complicated \- and it will get complicated
* Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the Head of Services
* Case study presentation \- project governance and risk scenario
* Offer

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you ready to shape the learning architecture of our digitally native airline and its workforce?
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary and commercially astute Director of Talent Development to lead our enterprise\-wide Learning \& Development strategy thereby building a future ready, safety centered and high\-performing organisation.
   

  

 Yours is a role responsible for building a future\-ready workforce that strengthens safety, performance, and long\-term growth. You are expected to oversee high\-impact learning delivery using blended, digital, simulation\-based, and experiential methods tailored to aviation.
   

  

 Partnering closely with senior leaders, you will ensure leadership depth, regulatory compliance, and workforce readiness across all functions.
   

  

 Importantly, your remit includes integrating leadership development, safety/compliance learning, operational training, and digital capability building into a unified enterprise framework. Further, you will design and implement a fully integrated airline learning ecosystem spanning safety, regulatory, operational, leadership, and digital capabilities.
   

  

 Central to your success in this role is the ability to own and manage the Talent Development budget, ensuring strategic ROI. Moreover, you will t rack and report KPIs including bench strength, capability readiness, and program effectiveness.
   

  

 You will also ensure regulatory alignment with key aviation bodies including the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Air Transport Association (IATA) and the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), integrating compliance requirements into enterprise learning frameworks and operational governance.
   

  

 If you are passionate about building future\-ready leaders, strengthening safety culture, and shaping capability at scale, we invite you to lead the next chapter of our talent journey.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 10 years of sound leadership experience within an L\&D or Talent Development capacity interpreting strategy and policy in order to set and deliver objectives within the medium to long term.
   

  

 We’d love to hear from you even more if you are a bilingual Saudi national with proven leadership experience.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

data.jd_text:
Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.
   

  

**The Project**
 This is an opportunity to work on one of the largest programmes in Saudi Arabia. This unique project consists of major mixed\-use development including sports facilities, entertainment, and arts along with all associated infrastructure.
   

  

 Mace is seeking an experienced Associate Director – MEP to join our team on a major international sports complex development. Acting in the role of Engineer, the position is accountable for leading the MEP design management, technical assurance, and compliance across the programme, ensuring safe, efficient, and fully coordinated MEP solutions from concept through delivery.
   

  

 The role will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, specialist designers, and construction stakeholders to ensure the MEP systems meet performance, quality, sustainability, and operational requirements expected of a world class sporting venue.
   

  

**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Lead and manage all MEP engineering and design management activities in the Engineer role across the project lifecycle.
* Provide technical leadership and governance for MEP disciplines, ensuring alignment with international standards, statutory requirements, and best practice.
* Manage the review, coordination, and approval of MEP design submissions, calculations, specifications, and technical reports.
* Oversee interface management between architectural, structural, and MEP disciplines to ensure fully integrated design solutions.
* Chair and contribute to technical workshops, design reviews, and coordination meetings.
* Support value engineering, buildability, and whole life performance optimisation of MEP systems.
* Provide guidance on energy efficiency, sustainability, low carbon design, and operational resilience suitable for a large scale sports venue.
* Manage and mentor MEP engineers and design managers, fostering high performance and technical excellence.
* Support procurement and tender activities, including technical evaluations of specialist contractors and suppliers.
* Monitor construction\-stage activities including technical queries, inspections, testing, commissioning, and handover support.
* Ensure robust technical risk management, change control, and quality assurance processes are applied throughout delivery.


**You’ll Need To Have**
* Proven experience in a senior MEP design management or engineering leadership role on large, complex developments.
* Strong background working in an Engineer, Consultant, or Design Authority role.
* Experience on sports, stadiums, arenas, or complex public assembly projects is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated capability across the full project lifecycle, from early design through construction and handover.
* Excellent understanding of international MEP design standards, codes, and regulations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience working in the Middle East and with fast\-paced, high\-profile programmes is advantageous.
* Necessary visa criteria for the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and have relevant work experience working on high\-valued projects/programmes for a project management consultancy business, which are required for immigration and client approval.


**Our values**
**Safety first \- Going home safe and well:** 
 We champion a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of well\-being in every team.
   

  

**Client focus \- Deliver on our promise:** 
 We own the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes and build long\-term relationships with our clients.
   

  

**Integrity \- Always do the right thing:** 
 We influence positive outcomes within our industry while always aligning with our compliance obligations.
   

  

**Create opportunity \- For our people to excel:** 
 We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.
   

  

 Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfill all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.
   

  

 We are also open to discussing part\-time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

* Ensure project processes and deliverables meet HSEQ and technical compliance standards and requirements
* Monitor and report on project progress, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

**Qualifications**
