 At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.
   

  

 Raytheon’s National Advanced Surface\-to\-Air Missile System (NASAMS) Program Team is seeking an
 **NASAMS In\-country Associate Director \- Program Management** 
 in Qatar. In this role, you will work closely with the Qatari Emiri Air Forces (QEAF) and our key OCONUS subcontractor, Kongsberg Air Defense (KDA).
   

  

 As part of the Short \& Medium Range Air Defense Systems Product Area within the Land and Air Defense Systems (L\&ADS) Strategic Business Unit, the team has successfully delivered NASAMS systems to Qatar and is now transitioning into operations and sustainment, with opportunities for product modernization.
   

  

 As the Senior Program Manager, you will report to the NASAMS Program Director within the MRAD Directorate and collaborate closely with the Qatar NASAMS Program Manager based in Andover, MA. Serving as the primary point of contact for Qatar NASAMS execution efforts in Doha, you will work in partnership with the Qatar NASAMS Program Manager to ensure a unified approach to program execution.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include managing subcontractor execution schedules with the KDA in\-country Project Manager to meet delivery commitments, supporting the CONUS Program Manager in preparing EACs and Program Review packages, and maintaining program infrastructure. This requires coordination across Raytheon functions, off\-sites, and international partners to ensure timely staffing, start\-up, and delivery of contractual products and services.
   

  

 You will lead in\-country teams for modernization, warranty, after\-sales support, repair \& return, and technical assistance, with responsibility for schedule and performance. This high\-visibility role involves daily interaction with the MRAD Directorate, regional and CONUS\-based functions, and senior\-level customer representatives, ensuring program success through cross\-functional collaboration and effective stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 This accompanied role will be in Doha, Qatar for a 2\-year international assignment on a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with potential extension.
   

  

 Ability to travel internationally (up to 25%) as needed.
   

  

 Employment is contingent upon meeting all medical requirements for overseas assignments including comprehensive post\-offer medical examination.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Oversee daily execution of the in\-country team, schedule, and performance for assigned contracts, ensuring compliance and fostering customer intimacy to support growth efforts.
* Serve as the primary operational Point of Contact for QEADF, providing procurement guidance, sustainment support, technical troubleshooting, and resource allocation for NASAMS Tactical Operations in Qatar.
* Direct in\-country team members, including site leads, warranty/logistics, quality, and technical personnel, to ensure maximum operational readiness for QEADF.
* Build strong partnerships with the major OCONUS subcontractor KDA, acting as the primary liaison between the NASAMS program office and subcontractor leadership.
* Drive timely resolution of issues, ensuring Raytheon and subcontractor concerns are addressed promptly.
* Support contract proposals, including bidding, negotiation, definitization, and start\-up processes.
* Develop and maintain a collaborative relationship with the QEAF customer, providing regular program updates and coordinating expectations with OCONUS and CONUS teams.
* Ensure subcontractor commitments meet financial, technical, and schedule requirements, escalating issues to the CONUS Program Manager as needed.
* Collaborate with internal functions, such as MRAD, Engineering, Contracts, Finance, Supply Chain, and Quality, to enhance program success.
* Manage subcontractor lifecycle deliverables and support customer program reviews and visits.
* Lead, mentor, and motivate the in\-country team to achieve program objectives while fostering a culture aligned with corporate vision and values.


**Qualifications You Must Have**
* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and 12\+ years of relevant experience or an Advanced degree and minimum 10\+ years of experience.
* PMX Certification Level 4, or ability to obtain within 12 months.
* CORE certification or process improvement equivalent.
* 7\+ years of experience in Program Management and Risk \& Opportunity Measures.
* Experience with large Air Defense weapon systems and prior military.
* Experience in program execution across System Integration, Fielding, Training, Operations, and Sustainment.
* Experience with financial analysis tools and project management tools and/or systems.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proven ability to effectively lead a cross\-functional team in an international environment.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively work with international customers.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued Secret security clearance is required.

* MBA or a graduate degree in engineering.
* Experience working in MENA region.
* Experience as a Senior Non\-commissioned Officer.
* Experience in international program execution, including collaboration with large international subcontractors and US Government programs.
* Strong working knowledge of EX/IM regulations, security requirements, and subcontract formation, execution, and management.
* Skilled in developing and reviewing cost proposals, as well as preparing Proposal Review and Contract Start\-up packages for management approval.
* Expertise in supporting development, production, sustainment, and execution of complex weapon systems, preferably within the aerospace and defense industry.
* Proficient in using Program Management tools or equivalent systems.

**What We Offer**
 Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The role will act as the senior onsite engagement lead for the client, governing end\-to\-end delivery, operational readiness, release management, platform stability, AI operations, and managed services execution across multiple enterprise platforms.
   

  

 The role is responsible for designing, launching, and scaling enterprise grade DataOps, MLOps, AI operations, CI/CD, application support, and managed services capabilities from the ground up. This includes enabling governance frameworks, operational standards, release governance processes, service management models, operational KPIs, support structures, and scalable delivery capabilities.
   

  

 In addition, the role plays a key leadership function in stakeholder management, capability development, business growth, and long\-term service expansion. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong leadership across Data \& AI delivery, production operations, organizational capability building, and executive stakeholder engagement within complex multi\-vendor environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Enterprise Platform Delivery \& Operations Leadership
* Own enterprise delivery and operational governance across multiple data platforms.
* Lead production readiness, hypercare governance, release management, operational acceptance, and transition into managed services.
* Govern enterprise platform lifecycle management including environment management, deployment governance, rollback planning, and operational stabilization.
* Ensure delivery alignment with strategic business objectives, roadmap priorities, operational timelines, and release schedules.
* Drive operational scalability, resiliency, observability, monitoring, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* DataOps, MLOps \& AI Operations
* Establish and scale enterprise\-grade DataOps, MLOps, CI/CD, and AI operations frameworks.
* Define operational standards for model deployment, monitoring, retraining coordination, drift management, inference operations, and AI governance controls.
* Govern AI operational readiness and support processes for enterprise AI use cases across multiple production platforms.
* Standardize release management, deployment automation, testing governance, and operational quality assurance processes.
* Managed Services \& Service Offering Development
* Design and scale enterprise Data \& AI managed services offerings covering platform operations, application support, DataOps, MLOps, and AI operations.
* Develop reusable operational frameworks, governance standards, support models, delivery playbooks, and service catalogs.
* Define L1/L2/L3 support operating models, escalation procedures, SLA structures, and operational KPIs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality, operational maturity, and delivery efficiency.
* Program Management \& Delivery Governance
* Lead delivery execution across multiple Data \& AI workstreams including data engineering, analytics, governance, AI enablement, and operational support.
* Monitor delivery progress, operational risks, issues, dependencies, and readiness activities across all programs.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, governance policies, cybersecurity requirements, and operational controls.
* Govern delivery reporting, performance tracking, financial oversight, and operational accountability.
* Stakeholder Leadership \& Client Engagement
* Act as the senior onsite engagement lead for Data \& AI programs and operations.
* Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, sector leadership, technical teams, and implementation partners.
* Lead executive governance forums, steering committees, operational reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
* Drive alignment across business, architecture, operations, AI, infrastructure, and governance stakeholders.
* Vendor \& Multi\-Partner Governance
* Govern multi\-vendor delivery and operational coordination across implementation partners, cloud providers, platform vendors, and support teams.
* Manage dependencies, escalation management, operational coordination, and delivery alignment across all involved parties.
* Capability Building, Staffing \& People Management
* Define the long\-term capability model required for sustainable enterprise Data \& AI operations.
* Lead workforce planning, staffing strategy, onboarding, capability development, and succession planning.
* Support recruitment and management of Data \& AI delivery, operations, governance, engineering, AI, PMO, and support resources.
* Coach and mentor teams to establish high\-performance delivery and operational practices.
* Business Growth \& Commercial Support
* Identify service expansion and upsell opportunities aligned with client strategic priorities.
* Support development of proposals, business cases, effort estimates, pricing models, and service expansion strategies.
* Manage delivery financials including forecasting, utilization tracking, operational efficiency, and margin optimization.
* Communication \& Executive Reporting
* Provide executive\-level dashboards, operational updates, release readiness reports, risk registers, and performance reporting.
* Lead communication planning and change management activities supporting operational adoption and stakeholder engagement.


**Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in enterprise Data \& AI delivery, platform operations, managed services, or digital transformation programs.
* Proven experience leading enterprise scale DataOps, MLOps, AI operations, or Data \& AI platform support organizations.
* Experience managing production critical enterprise platforms and large scale release programs.
* Experience establishing managed services, operational governance models, and scalable support capabilities from inception.
* Experience managing executive stakeholder relationships within government or large enterprise environments is highly preferred.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of DataOps, MLOps, CI/CD, enterprise data platforms, data architecture, data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, and analytics ecosystems.
* Experience operationalizing enterprise AI use cases in production environments.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML operationalization including model deployment, monitoring, retraining cycles, drift detection, inference operations, and AI governance controls.
* Familiarity with operational processes including testing governance, deployment pipelines, incident management, problem management, and service operations.


**Leadership \& Management Competencies**
* Excellent executive stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi\-disciplinary teams across delivery, operations, AI, engineering, governance, and support functions.
* Strong strategic thinking and operational leadership capabilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in complex, multi\-stakeholder, and multi\-vendor environments.


**Mandatory Requirements**
* Fluent in English communication skills required, Arabic language fluency is very much preferred.
* Willingness to work onsite and lead client\-facing engagement activities.

data.jd_text:
**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**Primary Objective**
 The Project Engineering Manager is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering framework for project execution, ensuring the effective delivery of multi\-disciplinary engineering and design activities across our offshore projects in Energy and hydrocarbon sectors.
   

  

**Specific Accountabilities**
**Engineering Leadership \& Execution**
* Establish and implement the project engineering execution framework, including procedures, deliverables, workflows, and interface management.
* Lead and coordinate multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across Feasibility/ Concept, FEED and Detailed Design phases.
* Direct the preparation and quality of engineering deliverables, ensuring alignment with scope, standards, and schedule requirements.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant design output, meeting customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Review and approve engineering execution strategies, project organization structures, and discipline responsibilities.
* Prepare and implement the Engineering management Plan on projects and ensure discipline schedules/budgets include safety and sustainability activities for the asset lifecycle.
* Manage technical Value Improvement Practices (VIPs) \- technology selection, value engineering, energy optimization, RAM, etc.


**Cross\-Discipline Coordination \& Interface Management**
* Provide overall integration across engineering disciplines, ensuring effective sequencing and interface management.
* Establish and maintain engineering coordination procedures with internal teams, licensors, contractors, and stakeholders.
* Oversee and manage interfaces between engineering, procurement, construction, and third\-party contractors.
* Ensure structured communication and resolution of technical queries and inter\-disciplinary conflicts.


**Technical Governance \& Quality Assurance**
* Ensure engineering activities comply with Worley standards, international codes, and customer specifications
* Must ensure maintaining engineering quality assurance processes, including document control, review cycles, and approval timelines.
* Lead the review and approval of key engineering documents, ensuring compliance with HSSEQ, operability, maintainability, and technical integrity requirements.
* Must ensure and participate in design reviews, safety studies, and technical assurance activities.
* Ensure required Technical Peer Reviews (TPRs) are planned, scheduled, and budgeted; proactively engage Location Director of Engineering when needed.


**Project Management \& Delivery**
* Overall key technical interface with customer management teams.
* Support the safe, on\-time, and within\-budget delivery of engineering scope across all project phases.
* Monitor engineering progress against schedule, budget, and deliverable milestones, identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans.
* Provide technical and commercial input to optimize design solutions and manage project risks.
* Ensure alignment between engineering outputs and project controls (cost, schedule, procurement needs).
* Maintain engineering registers for assumptions, holds, technical queries, deviations, key document changes, and SEAL decisions.


**HSSEQ \& Compliance**
* Champion Health, Safety, Security, Environment, and Quality culture within engineering activities.
* Ensure designs incorporate safe, sustainable, and environmentally compliant solutions.
* Ensure compliance with local and international regulatory frameworks and standards.


**Team Leadership \& Capability**
* Lead, mentor, and develop multi\-location engineering teams, ensuring effective resource allocation and competency.
* Ensure teams are appropriately staffed and aligned with project requirements.
* Foster collaboration across disciplines, offices, and stakeholders.
* Capture and implement lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Education**
* Full\-Time Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline of Engineering from an accredited University.
* Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status or undertaking the same will be an advantage.
* MME (Ministry of Municipality and Environment) engineering accreditation is a mandatory requirement. Candidates not holding this accreditation must be willing to achieve this within the probationary period.


**Job Specific Knowledge , Experience \& Competencies**
* Significant experience in oil \& gas, petrochemical, or energy sector projects.
* Must have proven experience as Project Engineering Manager / Engineering Manager on Pre\-FEED, FEED and Detailed Engineering projects during the last five years.
* Strong exposure to multi\-disciplinary engineering and global delivery teams.


**Technical \& Functional Competencies**
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, execution planning, and design assurance.
* Extensive knowledge of cross\-discipline integration, interfaces, and sequencing.
* Experience in engineering deliverables, specifications, and design review processes.
* Solid understanding of project lifecycle phases (Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, EPC).
* Familiarity with industry standards and customer specifications.
* Experience in risk management, change management, and technical decision\-making.


**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong leadership capability with ability to manage diverse, multi\-location teams.
* Effective communicator with the ability to influence technical and commercial decisions.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to manage complexity and conflicting priorities.
* High level of planning, organization, and execution discipline.
* Ability to operate in fast\-paced, multi\-project environments.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.raw_snippet:

 NUQ Library

data.jd_text:
**Department:** 
 NUQ Library
   

  

 Northwestern University in Qatar (NU\-Q) seeks an outstanding Director of the NU\-Q Library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library guides a team of library professionals with vision and purpose in support of NU\-Q vision of excellence in teaching, research, and mediamaking. Reporting to the Associate Dean for Education, the Director of the NU\-Q Library will provide collaborative leadership and strategic direction to the programs, services, initiatives, and collections of the NU\-Q Library. The successful candidate will be a forward\-thinking professional who is enthusiastic about advancing research, teaching, learning, and practice through access to NU\-Q Library resources, and knowledgeable about the complex nature of building, supervising, managing, and mentoring a collaborative team. The Director of the NU\-Q Library will facilitate partnerships in education and knowledge creation within Northwestern and beyond.
   

  

**Core Mission**
* Commitment to the core mission of NU\-Q as a global community of evidence\-based storytellers guided by the core values of excellence, collaboration, community, and sustainability
* Leadership and Strategic Vision
* Administration and Supervision
* Campus Engagement
* Professional and Ethical Practices and Innovation
* Assessment and Continuous Improvement


 The NU\-Q Library is a user\-focused library and serves the research and educational needs of NU\-Q faculty, staff, and students. The growing collection is made up of print, DVD/Blu\-ray, and electronic resources purchased and provided to support the curricular needs of the Communication Program which offers Media Industries and Technology major, the Journalism and Strategic Communication Program which offers Journalism major, and the Liberal Arts Program. The NU\-Q Library’s core mission is to coordinate and deliver robust reference services both in\-person and online, supporting research and learning across disciplines.
   

  

 The Director of the NU\-Q Library supports the university leadership and is responsible for the overall management and administration of the NU\-Q library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library oversees all aspects of NU\-Q Library staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment. With a keen eye on strategic planning and strategic resource management, the Director of the NU\-Q Library develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence. As a passionate advocate for the NU\-Q Library's core mission and services, the Director of the NU\-Q Library builds strong relationships with campus leadership and stakeholders, championing the library's essential role in academic excellence and student success. Through thoughtful planning and continuous assessment, the Director of the NU\-Q Library drives the development of innovative research support services and information resources. By partnering with faculty, academic departments, and student support teams, the Director of the NU\-Q Library helps elevate community members’ learning outcomes and ensures the library remains a vital, evolving hub of intellectual engagement. The Director of the NU\-Q Library fosters a culture of shared governance; advances the library culture of assessment through data collection; engages in evidence\-based decision\-making practices; and promotes a culture of accessibility, accountability, innovation, and ethical practices.
   

  

 There are also opportunities to collaborate with NU\-Q’s Institute for Advanced Study of the Global South (IAS), Artificial Intelligence and Media Lab (AIM\-Lab), and Media Majlis Museum (MMM). The IAS in the Global South at NU\-Q (\#IAS\_NUQ) produces and promotes evidence\-based storytelling focused on the histories, cultures, societies, and media of the Global South. The AIM\-LAB at NU\-Q produces and promotes data\-based storytelling focused on the intersection of artificial intelligence and media. MMM at NU\-Q is a museum dedicated to exploring journalism, communication, media and art.
   

  

 In the era of digital technologies and AI, libraries in media schools need to transition from a conventional resource center into an active catalyst for digital storytelling, research advancement, and ethical media innovation. They curate and provide access to multimedia collections, data journalism resources, AI\-driven production tools, and cutting\-edge media technologies. Beyond access, libraries in media schools are expected to cultivate advanced information literacy, AI literacy, critical understanding of algorithms, copyright compliance, academic integrity, and responsible AI integration in creative projects. They partner with faculty, staff, and students to confront misinformation, deepfakes, and data ethics challenges while upholding the highest standards of media research, media production, journalism practice, and creative scholarship.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Ph.D. in a subject area relevant to the core mission of Northwestern University in Qatar (communication studies, media studies, media design, cinema studies, journalism studies, liberal arts, etc.)


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Library and Information Science (MLIS) from an ALA\-accredited program.
* Minimum of 6 years of successful progressive leadership experience in university libraries (e.g., Assistant Director of Library and then Associate Director of Library required to support the Director of Library).
* Proven experience in and strong record of supervising, training, mentoring, and evaluating librarian faculty and staff members, fostering professional growth, contribution, and collaboration
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing and delivering library faculty/staff development programs
* Proven experience in and strong record of annual assessment of library services and implementation of long\-term strategies for the growth and innovation of library services
* Proven experience in and strong record of data collection and data analytics to inform evidence\-based decision\-making and service improvements
* Proven experience in and strong record of assessment of the effectiveness of library services, spaces, and collections in advancing student success and academic excellence
* Proven experience in and strong record of adoption of emerging technologies and innovative practices to enhance access, discovery, and research support
* Proven experience in and strong record of development and implementation of strategic initiatives that support institutional goals and accreditation requirements
* Proven experience in and strong record of university teaching and instructional design for information literacy
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing programs that showcase the role of university libraries in research, curricular use, and community engagement
* Proven experience in strategic planning, assessment practices, and advocacy in higher education environments.
* Proven experience in and strong record of building and maintaining effective partnerships and collaborations between the library, university leadership, academic departments, and the broader university community
* Proven experience in and strong record of dedication to student success
* Solid understanding of the organizational structure, organizational workflows, and approval chains in top\-tier universities
* Extensive knowledge of a broad range of issues and emerging trends in managing, collecting, and providing access to academic/university libraries
* Knowledge of Open Education Resources (OER) and affordable learning initiatives
* Comprehensive familiarity with the current trends in academic libraries, media schools, digital scholarship, and student learning support.
* Proven experience in budget and grant development and management
* Excellent communication, collaborative, interpersonal, and organizational skills
* Strong record of professional engagement and contribution, such as research, publications, and involvement in professional and scholarly organizations
* Strong record of progressively responsible experience working with a multidisciplinary team in academic/university libraries, including supervisory and leadership roles.
* Proven experience in and strong interest in applying new and emerging technologies to Library collections and archives, including digital scholarship and digital humanities initiatives
* Ability to demonstrate a calm, courteous, and professional demeanor when working with a variety of situations and/or people.
* Vision for leveraging emerging technologies, including the ethical application and use of artificial intelligence for library resources, services, and assessment
* Experience with collection development and maintenance, including databases and resources


***Please note this position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.***
**Responsibilities**
* Provide leadership to and management of a forward\-thinking NU\-Q Library, by playing a dynamic leadership role, guiding a team of library professionals with vision and purpose
* Oversee all aspects of staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment
* With a keen eye on strategic resource management, the Director develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence.
* Articulate a compelling vision for the NU\-Q Library and the value of the NU\-Q Library in supporting research, teaching, learning, and community engagement that aligns with the NU\-Q Library’s core mission and strategic directions
* Provide vision for NU\-Q Library collection development and stewardship. Establish priorities and develop policies that guide the development of library collections in alignment with the core mission of NU\-Q
* Establish strategic directions and priorities for a range of user\-centered services and programs that create exceptional experiences for the Northwestern community in support of their research, teaching, learning and practice with NU\-Q Library resources
* Provide leadership and oversight to the development of staff development programs and initiatives that establish the NU\-Q Library as a dynamic and innovative teaching and learning resource at Northwestern
* Provide overall direction for a team of 7 librarian faculty and staff members. Directly supervise Library faculty/staff members including librarians, library associate, and library assistants. Coordinate the department work. Provide mentorship, advocacy and support to all department staff and foster their professional engagement and growth
* Build and nurture collaborations and partnerships within the library, with faculty, academic departments, and the broader Northwestern community that strengthen and promote the key role and core mission of the NU\-Q Library in research, teaching, and community engagement
* Collaborate with library departments to advance the library’s digital transformation agenda to broaden discovery, access, and preservation of primary source materials in support of research and academic pursuits
* Represent the NU\-Q library in initiatives and events related to the strategic vision and priorities of the university within and outside NU\-Q. Contribute to the library’s leadership role in the field through projects, presentations, scholarship, and active participation in relevant professional organizations


**The anticipated salary range is $100,000 – $110,000 Commensurate with experience and qualifications.** 
 The pay offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on factors including (but not limited to) the experience and qualifications of the selected candidate including years since terminal degree, training, and field or discipline; departmental budget availability; internal comparators; and external market pay for comparable jobs.
   

  

 NU\-Q is a community of evidence\-based storytellers in the Global South. We are a globally embedded institution, being one of three campuses of Northwestern University (Chicago, Doha, Evanston) and one of several partner universities in the Qatar Foundation’s Education City in Doha, Qatar. Our mission is to mentor and educate students to become creative, ethical, and impactful communicators across cultural and national boundaries. We are committed to a vibrant student life, academic excellence, and high\-level undergraduate student research and media making, particularly on the Global South. Located at the confluence of continents, NU\-Q is a multidisciplinary global community with approximately 500 students from 60 countries.
   

  

 NU\-Q provides competitive compensation and benefits. The medium of instruction is English, but proficiency in Arabic or another regional language is an advantage at NU\-Q. Candidates with experience in US higher education as well as in the Arab region are particularly encouraged to apply. Northwestern University in Qatar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

 of Arizona State University (ASU), the requirements of the Education and Training Evaluation
   

  

 Commission (ETEC), and the National Commission for Academic Accreditation and Assessment
   

  

 (NCAAA).
   

  

 The Director leads a multidisciplinary team of instructors, coordinators, and academic support staff
   

  

 across General Education, English Language, Mathematics, and introductory discipline\-specific
   

  

 tracks. This position is accountable for student readiness outcomes, curriculum integrity, faculty
   

  

 development, and accreditation evidence across all Foundation Year academic operations. In Year
   

  

 1, the Director will serve as the primary architect of the Foundation Year model — building
   

  

 structures, policies, and quality systems from the ground up.

Syntys is a leading data center provider specializing in the design, construction, and management of data centers, catering to hyperscalers, AI infrastructure, and colocation wholesale providers across the MENA region. With a presence in more countries than any other provider in the region, Syntys is committed to delivering scalable, secure, and efficient digital infrastructure solutions. In this capacity, Syntys plays a pivotal role in supporting the region’s economic growth by fostering innovation and attracting investment in the digital economy.
 



  





 The DC Program Cost Manager is responsible for the financial and commercial management of projects, ensuring effective cost control, budgeting, forecasting, contract support, and value optimization across the project lifecycle. The role integrates cost management and commercial oversight, ensuring projects are delivered within budget, financially optimized, and aligned with contractual obligations, while providing accurate reporting and supporting strategic decision\-making.

* Develop and manage project budgets, cost plans, and financial forecasts.

* Identify and manage commercial risks and opportunities, ensuring financial protection.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* 10\+ years of experience in commercial management, cost control, or quantity surveying.

* Strong knowledge of FIDIC and commercial frameworks.
* Professional certifications preferred (MRICS, RICS, PMP).
* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering or related field.

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 talabat is the leading food and Q\-commerce marketplace in Qatar, delivering food, groceries \& more to thousands of customers on a daily basis. We are seeking a Managing Director (MD) for Qatar who excels in dynamic, fast paced environments, with a knack for problem solving. The MD of Qatar should have an entrepreneurial, strategic mindset, with a mission to unlock new avenues of growth for talabat, whether by expanding our food business, further scaling our Q\-commerce business, or growing our ecosystem products (i.e. Subscription, Rewards, Fintech).
   

  

 The MD of Qatar will be tasked to elevate the performance of the existing organisation and simplify its operating model, maximising synergies between functions \& verticals. Team leadership and culture building are key skill sets needed to thrive in this role. The MD of Qatar will be a senior member of the talabat Management team, and will be the ultimate owner of the full P\&L (on a strategic, tactical, and day to day level).

**Role**
 In this role, you will represent the local voice to regional teams, while working closely with the Chief International Officer (CIO) and other C\-level executives to:
   

  

* Shape a seamless, effective operating model, across all business verticals (food \& Q\-commerce).
* Maximize synergies across teams, programs and verticals, and build a culture of growth.
* Define quarterly OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) and priorities for Qatar team.
* Act as the key 'customer' for the Product and Technology organization, collaborating to set priorities and solve problems.

+ Designing and executing the strategy and business plan for talabat in Qatar.
+ Preparing and negotiating annual budgets, ensuring EBITDA targets are met on a monthly, quarterly \& annual basis, and recommending additional investments if necessary.
+ Leading a large, diverse team across multiple programs and verticals.
+ Overseeing day\-to\-day operations in key functions such as logistics, marketing, sales, performance and partnerships, while representing the company in legal matters, public relations, communications, and government relations.
+ Identifying and analyzing opportunities for accelerated growth across various programs and verticals.
+ Leveraging data to drive decision making, whether to address day\-to\-day problems, or tackle long term opportunities.
+ Launching local, regional, and global transformational programs, and driving continuous improvement initiatives that can scale globally.


**Qualifications**
 As the ideal candidate, you will have a proven track record in driving successful operations, and implementing core strategies that impact both top\-line and bottom\-line results, preferably in leadership positions. With experience in uncovering problems and designing solutions for dynamic and fast\-paced businesses, you are passionate about your work and adept at navigating complex systems daily to deliver business impact.

data.jd_text:
Syntys is a leading data center provider specializing in the design, construction, and management of data centers, catering to hyperscalers, AI infrastructure, and colocation wholesale providers across the MENA region. With presence in more countries than any other provider in the region, Syntys is committed to delivering scalable, secure, and efficient digital infrastructure solutions.
 



  





 As a Senior Construction Project Manager (Data Centers), you will step into a pivotal client\-side leadership role, seamlessly integrating with executive teams to drive massive\-scale infrastructure projects from inception to completion. This isn't just about managing timelines; it’s about strategic governance. You will take full ownership of the project lifecycle—managing program, cost, and exceptional quality standards—while effortlessly bridging the communication gap between key project stakeholders and the PMC. If you have a proven track record of steering complex data center builds to successful conclusions, we want you at the helm.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* **Strategic Governance:** 
 Provide overarching leadership to set up project teams, establish robust controls, implement quality standards, and offer critical buildability and technical advice.
* **Communication \& Liaison:** 
 Serve as the central focal point and strategic "filter" between the Client, consultants, and contractors to ensure fast, transparent, and effective information flow.
* **Risk \& Change Control:** 
 Proactively monitor the project Risk Plan (contingency and drawdowns) and rigorously manage the Change Control system.
* **Design Management:** 
 Facilitate design team/contractor procurement (including bid and contract placement) and manage the design process to ensure flawless execution of client requirements.
* **Site Operations:** 
 Oversee the release of timely CAIs (Confirmation of Architect's Instructions) with actionable build data, and strictly manage the coordination of Health \& Safety issues.
* **Financial Oversight:** 
 Manage construction budgets with a sharp focus on cost control, providing weekly financial updates, variance tracking, and risk/opportunity logs to senior leadership.
* **Milestone Tracking:** 
 Formalize and track detailed delivery programmes, paying critical attention to high\-level milestones, enabling works, and specialized sequences (e.g., BMS \& Commissioning).
* **Meeting Architecture:** 
 Establish and chair a structured cadence of meetings, including weekly client project/design meetings, fortnightly change control updates, and coordination/Value Engineering workshops.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Act as the bridge between specialized project tracks, maintaining close liaison with move teams, security, maintenance, IT, AV, and end\-users.
* **Contract Completion:** 
 Formally verify that all works are completed in strict accordance with contract parameters and manage the design team's snagging/de\-snagging process.
* **Documentation \& Compliance:** 
 Ensure full compilation of O\&M manuals, Health \& Safety files, and all necessary witnessing/testing documentation.



  





**What You’ll Bring (Qualifications \& Experience):**

 Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

 Fluency in

 is required;

 Minimum of

 A proven track record of steering large\-scale projects through all phases: design, construction, and commissioning (Cx).

data.jd_text:
**Data Centre, Technical \& Engineering Director** 




**Doha, Qatar** 




  





  






 Position Overview:
 




  





 The Technical \& Engineering Director position will be working within the businesses EPC Power \& Digital division, on all MENA data centre project.
 



  





 The role is responsible for the end\-to\-end technical integrity of data centre projects from front\-end definition through to construction handover, ensuring that power, cooling, civil, and ICT systems are designed to hyperscale and colocation standards and are fully constructable and operable at commissioning.
 



  





 Working in close alignment with the EPC Chief Operations Officer the Technical \& Engineering Director serves as the day\-to\-day technical authority on assigned projects, owning design standards, discipline coordination, OEM interfaces, and technical risk management across the full delivery lifecycle.
 



  





 Some travel to construction sites across MENA will be required when necessary.
 



  






 Key Responsibilities:
 




  




* Lead multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across power, cooling, civil/structural, and ICT disciplines
* Own technical standards and design basis documentation through to FEED
* Ensure all designs are constructable, installation logic aligned, and ready for site execution
* Manage inter discipline coordination and clash resolution using 3D plant modelling tools (REVIT, etc.)
* Oversee HV/MV/LV power architecture design including utility intake, MV switchgear, transformers, and LV distribution
* Manage UPS, battery storage, and generator system design and OEM interfaces
* Ensure power redundancy models are correctly implemented, targeting AI\-ready campuses
* Coordinate protection, metering, and power quality studies with specialist consultants
* Lead cooling system design including air\-side economization, chillers, air cooling, and liquid cooling for high\-density AI compute
* Target PUE benchmarks in line with hyperscale client requirements; industry benchmark for AI campuses is 1\.2–1\.4 PUE
* Oversee plumbing, drainage, HVAC, and fire suppression system design and integration
* Interface with energy modelling teams to validate system performance and efficiency projections
* Manage civil and structural design scope including foundations, raised floor systems, data halls, and façade
* Ensure structural designs accommodate equipment loadings, seismic considerations, and phased capacity expansion
* Oversee M\&E services coordination within building fabric to eliminate site clashes and rework
* Oversee ICT infrastructure design including structured cabling, fiber backbone, and carrier\-neutral meet\-me rooms
* Ensure DCIM\-readiness is embedded in design from the outset to support operational efficiency post\-handover
* Coordinate with network operators and hyperscale clients on connectivity and meet\-me room requirements
* Engage the commissioning team from FEED stage to ensure testability and safe energization sequences are designed in
* Define and review CX documentation including CX plans, ITPs, FAT and SAT procedures
* Ensure technical handover packages are complete, accurate, and meet client O\&M requirements
* Embed safety by design principles across all engineering disciplines
* Own HAZOP/HAZID planning and chairing, ensuring action close\-out is tracked
* Manage quality assurance processes for design deliverables including review gates, checking, and sign\-off
* Act as primary technical interface with hyperscale and colocation clients during design development
* Lead technical clarification meetings with clients, authorities, and utility providers



  






 Qualifications \& Experience
 




  




* Degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline (BEng / MEng)
* 10\+ years of engineering experience in mission\-critical facilities or data centre projects
* Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or large\-scale colocation data centre projects
* Deep working knowledge of data centre power architecture
* Strong cooling systems experience
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary design teams of 10\+ engineers
* Experience with FEL/FEED\-driven delivery models
* Proficiency in design tools including AutoCAD, REVIT, or equivalent
* Working experience in the Middle East or comparable international markets
* LEED, BREEAM, or equivalent sustainability certification experience
* Familiarity with hyperscale client design standards (Google, Microsoft Azure, Meta, AWS, Oracle)



  





 This is a full time, 5 days\-a\-week head office position in Doha, Qatar.

**Job Description**
 Wood is accepting expressions of interest for a Project Control Manager to join our team in Qatar.
   

  

 Project Control Manager leads the cost; planning, scheduling and risk assessment support to assignments / project teams and clients, typically on projects of moderate size and complexity. Oversees the set up and running of all required project controls systems, tools and interfaces to allow successful management and reporting of the project costs, schedule and risks on projects and specific assignments. Responsible for managing a team of project control resources in support of project delivery excellence
   

  

 The role interfaces with a number of key stakeholders across the project and wider business. Primary focal point for the Project Manager, Client or Project Team for all matters relating to project costs, schedules and risk; and resources requirements. Develops and implements the project control execution plan for projects of moderate size and complexity
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Act as the focal point with the client and any contractor Project Controllers as appropriate to ensure costs and progress are reported accurately, ensure alignment with the project reporting requirements and ensure timely and accurate cost and progress reporting
* Monitor overall project / assignment progress status, achievement and non\-achievement of major milestones and analyse and forecast performance in relation to plan
* Identification, monitoring and reporting against the project critical path providing early warning to the Project Manager of any potential slippages
* Identifies and establishes the communications interfaces essential for the delivery of cost, planning, scheduling and risk deliverables and services
* Report project status and KPI to management
* Develops the project Work Breakdown Structure?
* Manage the implementation of the cost and planning control structures in alignment with the project Work Breakdown Structure
* Manage and oversee the project work approval process in terms of accurate cost code allocation and initial budget set\-up and approvals
* Timely control and forecasting of budgets and ensure that the impact of all change requests are properly assessed and included in the budget and schedules if applicable
* Accountable for accuracy and timeliness of S\-curves and histograms produced by team
* Accountable for delivery and ongoing maitenance of the projects fully resourced, logic linked Gantt Charts within preferred planning software to the agreed project and programme requirements
* Accountable for providing analysis of current and future resource needs for the project and programme to the Project Manager
* Manages and oversees the recovery process followig identified slippages or significant float erosion
* Responsible for timely and accurate development and issuing of project change orders / variations in accordance with contract / assignment change notifications
* Promote the project change management system and facilitate assurance activities to ensure the process is adhered to
* Serve as Chair for ongoing internal team and client team Project Controls meetings (Cost, Schedule and Progress).
* Oversee the preparation of proposal schedules and CTR packs
* Lead cost and schedule risk analysis workshops / sessions both internally and with clients
* Ensure risk is managed and monitored at project level in line with local standards and processes
* Ensure Project Controls processes and procedures are accurate, that the project controls team are familiar with them and comply with their requirements
* Responsible for ensuring that projects are managed effectively to ensure delivery in a manner which meets quality, time and budget specifications
* Accountable for the accuracy and completeness of all cost, planning and risk deliverables prior to issue to internal or external customer
* Responsible for ensuring all project specific control tools and systems are set up and functioning adequately
* Manage the workload, performance and development of the project controls team. Provides constructive feedback and coaching.
* Responsible for ensuring project control staff are competent to carry out assigned work
* Reviews contractual obligations and ensures that cost control activities are performed in accordance with the contractual agreements and the Client’s requirements
* Ensuring that lessons learned are captured and implemented in support of continuous improvement
* Motivates project control team to meet project aims; promotes communication and teamwork within group and project.


**Qualifications**
* B.S. or equivalent degree
* Minimum of 15\+ years relevant experience in major Brownfield oil \& gas projects, including at least five (5\) years in similar position
* Pre\-FEED, FEED experience
* Typically requires a minimum of eight (8\) years of relevant industry experience, with at least six (6\) years in project control positions.
* Excellent client service focus
* Exceptional organisational skills and able to multi\-task"
* Working knowledge of risk management processes and techniques and experience in facilitating Risk workshops with project / assignment teams
* Advanced Working Knowledge of relevant software tools such as Microsoft Project and Primavera


**About Us**
 Wood is a global leader in consulting and engineering, helping to unlock solutions to critical challenges in energy and materials markets. We provide consulting, projects and operations solutions in 45 countries, employing around 25,000 people. www.woodplc.com
   

  

**Diversity Statement**
 We are an equal opportunity employer that recognises the value of a diverse workforce. All suitably qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment on the basis of objective criteria and without regard to the following (which is a non\-exhaustive list): race, colour, age, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or other characteristics in accordance with the relevant governing laws.

**Job Purpose**
 The Projects Manager will execute fast\-track fit\-out projects for retail stores, F\&B outlets, hotels, and commercial offices. Working independently, he/she will be responsible for the overall planning, coordination, and management of multiple projects by leading multi\-disciplinary teams including subcontractors through project activities to meet client requirements and complete projects successfully, safely, within quality, within budget and on\-time.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Areas**
 The PM oversees the overall management of projects and client servicing on behalf of the Company, encompassing the following functions:
   

  

**1\-Project Management**
* Review tender programmes and convert them into construction programmes, including defining the client’s direct procurement requirements and client meetings calendar
* Specify project objectives and plans including site set\-up, planning and logistics. Delineation of scope, budgeting, scheduling, setting performance requirements, selection of project sub\-contractors and allocating internal resources (e.g., QA/QC, Health and Safety and MEP Management)
* Set targets for procurement packages and vet sub\-contractors’ tenders
* Decide on purchasing requirements (whether within or outside subcontractors’ remit)
* Ensure projects teams have sufficient resources, equipment, and labour. Plan into order to meet the project timescales and quality requirements
* Attend all site meetings with client and/or consultants as Company representative
* Approve interim payments for subcontractors and their final accounts
* Approve the Company’s interim valuations before submission to our client/consultant
* Liaise and cooperate with in\-house departments such as joinery manufacturing in Bahrain
* Maximise resource efficiency (e.g., labour, materials, and equipment)


**2\-Performance Management**
* Oversee the construction sites and associated site teams, and the management of vendors and trade subcontractors
* Maintain accurate records of construction progress across all projects and report to senior management on a weekly basis
* Ensure good communication between the Company and clients at all times
* Be responsible for health and safety on all sites under his management
* Ensure workers follow Company procedures
* Manage the rectification process on\-time and on\-budget
* Compile and submit Operations and Maintenance (O\&M) manuals to the clients upon project completion
* Manage close out procedure for all projects in accordance with contractual obligations and to high quality standards thereby compelling clients to give a positive review or testimonial


**Candidate Requirements**
* The Projects Manager (PM) should have worked with reputable fit\-out contracting companies in the Middle East for at least 7\-8 years
* Minimum of 10 years’ total work experience in the same field
* Very strong technical, execution and commercial abilities with sound knowledge of the woodworking business particularly the technical aspects relating to joinery and good manufacturing practices of timber, veneers, hardware, etc
* Proven track record as a successful leader at senior management level within the fit\-out industry
* A very good knowledge of latest developments in the fit\-out market. The candidate should be well\-versed with the current trends and news influencing market and be able to suggest ideas to boost the Company’s industry presence and build our brand
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to work successfully in a multinational market environment

Monitor the management of financial and non\-financial risks pertaining to the CCM production in partnership with local NFR/Business Risk.

* Manage multiple senior stakeholders with varied and sometimes conflicting agendas, effectively navigating complex situations and driving alignment.

* Extensive years of experience in wholesale credit and lending, with a strong background in coverage, credit management or operations
* Proven track record of leading and managing teams, with experience in organizational design and strategic planning.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders.

data.jd_text:
**1\. Job Purpose** 




  





 To provide administrative support to the Board of Directors and associated committees. Execute streamlining of board communication and collaboration, overseeing logistics, documentation, feedback, planning, and compliance for enhanced governance and organizational success, providing comprehensive support to enhance board performance and uphold standards.
 



  





**2\. Position Accountability Description** 




**Board Operations Management** 




  




1. Formulate and maintain a comprehensive board operations manual to guide activities effectively, ensuring clarity and alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards. Incorporate regular staff input for continuous improvements and superior functionality, resulting in a more robust and user\-friendly manual.
2. Collaborate with executive leadership to meticulously draft, review, and finalize board meeting agendas and materials, incorporating feedback, fostering collaboration, and ensuring adherence to governance and compliance requirements.
3. Arrange logistical details for board meetings, meticulously overseeing scheduling, venue selection, catering arrangements, technology setup, and promptly resolving any unforeseen challenges.
4. Provide and distribute meeting materials to board members in advance, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, customization according to preferences, secure distribution channels, and thorough content coverage.
5. Support board affairs director to analyze board meetings to record precise minutes, capturing nuanced discussions, decisions, action items, key points, highlighting follow\-ups, and facilitating efficient dissemination and implementation of outcomes.
6. Distribute prepared action plans coming out of the board \& committees meetings to relevant parties and follow up on the implementation of action plans.



  





**Document and Information Management** 




  




1. Track an organized repository of board documents meticulously, ensuring systematic categorization, version control, security protocols, accessible data, confidentiality, and streamlined retrieval processes for enhanced operational efficiency.
2. Undertake board member onboarding processes strategically, offering tailored induction sessions, facilitating informed access to pertinent resources, enabling seamless integration, fostering relationships, aligning with strategic goals, and promoting engagement.
3. Contribute to and collect detailed feedback from directors to compile comprehensive reports, analyzing insights, trends, performance metrics, and areas for improvement, and presenting synthesized recommendations for concerned committee review and strategic decision\-making.
4. Analyze board member evaluations and self\-assessment processes, compiling results, identifying areas for improvement, and recommending development opportunities to enhance board performance, while tracking progress, providing personalized feedback, and ensuring alignment with the board's goals.



  





**Board Communication and Support** 




  




1. Serve as the primary point of contact for board \& committees inquiries, managing communications professionally, providing timely responses, clarifying information, addressing concerns skillfully, nurturing relationships, and upholding a positive board \& committees experience.
2. Support board affairs director to Aadvise Board and Committee members on tailored communications strategies, fostering effective interactions with internal and external stakeholders, enhancing transparency and alignment, fostering collaboration, and promoting a harmonious working environment for organizational success.
3. Establish and maintain effective communication channels between the board and senior management, ensuring key information flows smoothly and providing timely updates on organizational performance and strategic initiatives.



  





**Event Coordination** 




  




1. Coordinate board retreats and strategic planning sessions, including agenda development, facilitator selection, and the creation of supporting materials to drive productive discussions and outcomes.
2. Prepare a comprehensive annual calendar of board and committee activities, meetings, and events, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and timely notification to all board members, incorporating feedback, key deadlines, and strategic milestones for optimal planning.
3. Help to create and execute special board events, such as recognition ceremonies, award presentations, and networking opportunities, to foster camaraderie and appreciation among board members, coordinating guest speakers, thematic elements, and leveraging social media to highlight achievements.



  





**Governance and Compliance** 




  




1. Oversee the development and maintenance of a comprehensive board and committees members skills matrix, identifying gaps and recommending targeted recruitment to ensure a diverse and effective board, incorporating emerging competencies, succession planning needs, and strategic alignment with organizational goals.
2. Support the Chairman in conducting board evaluations, compiling performance metrics, and providing actionable insights and recommendations for enhancing board effectiveness by facilitating post\-evaluation discussions, addressing identified issues, clarifying roles, and setting clear improvement goals.
3. Ensure compliance with all governance policies and procedures, conducting regular reviews, recommending updates, and ensuring adherence to ethical standards and legal requirements, while integrating best practices, stakeholder feedback, and proactive risk management strategies for continuous improvement. Ensure all rules and bylaws are adhered to by the board \& committees members during meetings and in the implementation of their decisions.



  





**Innovation and Continuous Improvement** 




  




1. Continuously benchmark Board operations practices against industry standards, adopting improvements to enhance efficiency and governance effectiveness.
2. Implement and monitor process improvements by analyzing current Board operations practices, identifying inefficiencies, and applying best practices to streamline workflows.
3. Explore and adopt new technologies and tools that can improve Board operations, keeping the team at the forefront of innovation and efficiency.
4. Foster a high\-performance culture by striving for excellence and encouraging peers, contributing to the overall success and continuous improvement of the Board operations team.



  





**Team Collaboration and Continuous Learning** 




  




1. Work collaboratively with team members and DACO management by sharing knowledge, providing support, and actively participating in team activities to foster a positive and productive work environment.
2. Engage in continuous learning by seeking feedback, attending training sessions, and staying updated on industry trends to enhance personal skills and professional growth.



  





  





 3\. Minimum Job Requirements
 


* 
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Management, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of progressive experience in board management, corporate governance, compliance, legal or a related field.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Tiered Approach**
 In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby
   

  

* Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates


 Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
   

  

**Background**
 The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Country Office in the Kingdom of Bahrain operates within the context of a high\-income, net\-contributing country, where UNDP engagement is fully funded through government cost\-sharing and aligned with national development priorities. Bahrain is implementing an ambitious national reform agenda under Bahrain Vision 2030 and the Government Programme (2023–2026\), with a strong focus on economic diversification, fiscal sustainability, effective governance, environmental resilience, digital transformation, and inclusive human development. As a net contributor country, UNDP Bahrain maintains a lean operational footprint while delivering high\-value technical assistance, policy advisory services, and innovation\-driven solutions in support of national priorities.
   

  

 UNDP Bahrain’s programme is guided by the Country Programme Document (CPD) 2025–2029, approved by the UNDP Executive Board in January 2025, and is fully aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2025–2029\. The financial envelope for the 2025–2029 Country Programme Document (CPD) is structured around a total estimated cost of US 2\.5 million for Economic Prosperity (Outcome 1\) and US 5 million for Environmental Sustainability (Outcome 3\). As of late 2025, the Country Office manages seven ongoing projects with a total remaining budget of approximately US$ 1\.8 million. These initiatives are distributed across the three CPD outcomes: Outcome 1 (Economic Prosperity) and Outcome 3 (Environmental Sustainability) each account for about 37–38% of the project count, while Outcome 2 (Governance) makes up the remaining 25%. Notable projects Youth Leadership Program, King Hanad Ward for SDGs, National Human Development Report in partnership with DERASAT. A new generation of projects is expected to be developed under this Outcome.
   

  

 The CPD Positions UNDP As a Trusted Strategic Partner To The Government Of Bahrain, Contributing To UNSDCF Outcomes Through Integrated, Multi\-sectoral Interventions That Address Complex Development Challenges At The Intersection Of Economic Prosperity, Governance And Human Rights, And Environmental Sustainability. Under The Country Programme Document (CPD) 2025–2029, UNDP Bahrain’s Engagement Is Structured Around Three Interrelated CPD Pillars
   

  

 (i) Economic prosperity and sustainable livelihoods;
   

  

 (ii) Effective governance, human rights, and access to justice; and
   

  

 (iii) Environmental sustainability and climate resilience.
   

  

 These pillars reflect national priorities under Bahrain Vision 2030 and the Government Programme (2023–2026\), and constitute UNDP’s substantive contribution to the implementation of the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2025–2029\.
   

  

 To ensure coherence, integration, and efficient delivery within a lean Country Office structure, the Bahrain CO operationalizes the three CPD pillars through two integrated programme clusters. The first cluster brings together
 **economic transformation, sustainable livelihoods, and environmental sustainability** 
 , The second cluster focuses on
 **governance, human rights, access to justice, and social inclusion** 
 .
   

  

 This two\-cluster delivery model enables the Country Office to manage complexity, promote synergies across CPD pillars, and apply a portfolio approach to programme design, implementation, and partnerships. Staff are therefore expected to work across thematic boundaries, contribute to integrated solutions, and support joint programming within the UN system, while ensuring results\-based management, quality assurance, and alignment with national and UNSDCF priorities.
   

  

 Under the direct supervision of the Transition Manager (P4\) and overall guidance of the Resident Representative and in close collaboration with the rest of the Country Office programme team, the Programme Analyst \- Governance, Human Rights and Social Inclusion (GHRSI) will manage the oversight, accountability, and coordination of this programme area.
   

  

**The Programme Analyst Is Therefore Entrusted With**
* Contributing to setting the strategic direction of the area and the overarching UNDP Country Office programme as it related to this thematic area.
* Aiding in the management and coordination of the programme portfolio and team.
* Forging and growing broad\-based strategic partnerships, support to resource mobilization and strategic expansion.
* Provision of quality policy advice services to the Government and other relevant stakeholders, and facilitation of dynamic learning and knowledge that informs strategic programming and fuels programmatic impact.


 The
 **Programme Analyst** 
 leads the Governance, Human Rights, and Social Inclusion cluster, providing strategic oversight and leadership to strengthen Bahrain's governance systems and rule of law. The role focuses on capacity building for judiciary and law enforcement, promoting gender equality. Additionally, the Analyst is responsible for fostering civic participation platforms for youth and women, managing partnerships with civil society and academia, and driving
 **resource mobilization** 
 to ensure the portfolio's long\-term sustainability.
   

  

 S/he endeavors to integrate the GHRSI cluster with the Economic Prosperity and Environment unit by fostering institutional innovation and evidence\-based public sector management to support a responsive digital economy. This cross\-cutting collaboration focuses on aligning digital transformation policies with international human rights standards and inclusive participation frameworks. Together, both clusters leverage data\-driven policy and statistical capacity building to ensure that innovation pipelines remain equitable and leave no one behind
   

  

 The incumbent also works in strong collaboration with the Regional Hub in Amman, as well as other regional and global UNDP Hubs, and professional and knowledge networks.
   

  

 UNDP personnel are expected to embrace innovative thinking and work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams that actively connect knowledge and skills around issues to ensure higher programmatic coherence and drive transformative changes.
   

  

 The incumbent is expected to display innovation, problem solving, trouble shooting, active initiative, and a strong client orientation that encourages and rewards excellence in programme delivery and implementation. S/he might be required to undertake emerging tasks and additional duties as requested by senior management.
   

  

 UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Substantively contribute to formulation and implementation of UNDP programme strategies and policies on Governance, Human Rights, Social Inclusion:
* Contribute to analysis of the political, social and economic situation in the country; and contribute collaborative inputs to the UN Common Country Assessment and Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNCCA and UNSDCF) as well as to the preparation/revision of the Country Programme Document (CPD), Integrated Work Plan (IWP) and other strategic documents.
* Contribute to operationalizing UNSDCF/ CPD in collaboration with the main partners and other UN Agencies.
* Ensure implementation of relevant programme Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure the effectiveness of CO business processes.
* Analyze and synthesize proposals in assigned programme areas.
* Provides input into the integrated design of new development interventions (e.g., projects, etc.).
* Liaises with national and international partners, etc. in strategic programme areas of cooperation.
* Engages with colleagues in the Amman Regional Hub and Headquarters to apply in country programming new global and regional initiatives, polices and knowledge products that further the Governance, Human Rights and Social Inclusion programme.
* Ensure effective management of the CO programme within the assigned thematic/sector areas focusing on quality assurance and risk management from formulation to implementation of the country programme:
* Contribute to design and formulation of CO programme, translate UNDP priorities into local interventions, and oversee programme implementation with the implementing partners within the assigned programme areas. Ensure that design and formulation of programme considers societal digital technology risks and opportunities and other future signals.
* Oversee planning, budgeting, implementation and monitoring of the assigned programme areas; and track use of financial resources in accordance with UNDP rules and regulations. Ensure digital technology solutions in programme implementation are managed towards scalability and sustainability in line with UNDP’s digital standards.
* Ensure effective application of results\-based management tools and track achievement of strategic results.
* Ensure the effective use of data in programme implementation, across the data lifecycle; and ensure effective monitoring, evaluation and learning on programme impact.
* Support trends analysis for future informed and anticipatory programming.
* Follow up on audit recommendations and ensure the implementation of management responses.
* Prepare and aggregate reports on activities, outputs and outcomes, including donor and corporate reports.
* Support the rollout of new initiatives and programmes including through presentation of the project to PAC; finalize contribution agreements; and determine required revisions.
* Ensure creation of strategic partnerships and implementation of the resource mobilization strategy:
* Develop partnerships with the UN Agencies, international financial institutions (IFIs), government institutions, donors, private sector (if applicable to CO), and civil society in assigned programme/ thematic areas.
* Identify strategic programme areas of cooperation including joint programming.
* Analyze and research information on donors, prepare substantive briefs on possible areas of cooperation, identify opportunities for initiation of new projects, and substantively contribute to Country office resource mobilization efforts.
* Support development of portfolios and Country office pipeline including through the design of Programme/Project documents, concept notes, proposals, and cross\-sectoral coordination in assigned areas to bring resources for projects.
