data.title: Global Head of ESG Risks & CRO Bahrain
data.raw_snippet: Incumbent is expected to lead the global coordination of ESG \& Climate risk related governance, policy universe, regulatory reporting, gap analysis \& remediation against various home and host country regulations. Incumbent will be responsible for management of all classes of risks for Mashreq Bahr
data.jd_text:
Incumbent is expected to lead the global coordination of ESG \& Climate risk related governance, policy universe, regulatory reporting, gap analysis \& remediation against various home and host country regulations. Incumbent will be responsible for management of all classes of risks for Mashreq Bahrain in coordination with HO Risk (retail and wholesale branch). Incumbent is expected to meet all regulatory and management\-related expectations on risk management in coordination with Central Functions in Head Office.
 



  





**Global Head of ESG Risks** 



* Development, maintenance and implementation of group wide ESG \& climate risk related policy universe. e.g. Climate Risk Policy, ESG Risk policy, Inputs to other risk management policy universe for embedding ESG risk into policy universe in coordination with other relevant stakeholders.
* Ensuring inputs required from Risk management for all disclosures related to, Net zero, Transition planning etc. are fulfilled and coordinated.
* Focal point of coordination for ESG Risks related matters across Mashreq Group supporting country risk managers for coordination and management of ESG risks across Mashreq’s Presence countries overseas including escalation, alignment, and best‑practice sharing.
* Establishing ESG risks related roles and responsibilities across the organization via appropriate governance of ESG risk at the relevant management committees, forums, workshops, conferences and other events in areas of ESG \& climate risk. e.g. Group Risk committee, BRCESGC, IBG ESG Committee, ESG Committee, Sustainability Executive committee etc.
* Conducting gap analysis, roadmaps and remediation plans for various ESG \& climate risk related regulatory guidelines and associated regulatory submissions e.g. CB UAE climate risk principles and regulation.
* Ownership of ESG risk measurement oversight and ensuring compliance with all internal policies and procedures
* Change management for ESG \& climate risk related initiatives and automation projects in coordination with ESG team, One Data \& Technology, External consultants and other stakeholders across three lines of defense while ensuring compliance with data governance standards and coordination with enterprise data teams and designated data champions.
* Supporting the development and enhancement of various regulatory reporting disclosures like GRI, ESG Reporting, ISSB, IFRS S1 and S2, Pillar 3 disclosures etc. with ESG \& climate related financial risks inputs across home and host countries regulations.
* Supporting the internal \& external capacity building initiatives via training and awareness around ESG \& climate risk



  





**Chief Risk Officer Bahrain** 



* Country Risk Manager Bahrain will be a regulatory function responsible for coordination \& management of governance of all risk classes for Mashreq Bahrain in coordination with HO Risk
* Act as credit risk management local coordinator for the outsourced element to head office credit management group
* The incumbent will act as a secretary of Bahrain Risk Committee and will be focal point of coordination for day\-to\-day coordination around management of all risk classes in coordination with HO Risk. Management of Bahrain Risk Committee, Charter/TOR, minutes of meeting.
* Implementation of International Risk Management framework for Mashreq Bahrain. Maintenance, reporting \& monitoring of Level 3 Country Risk Appetite for Bahrain
* Responsible for maintenance of Local risk management related policy \& process notes \& CORR and handling of regulatory requirements.
* Point person for supporting Business and support function coordination pertaining to Enterprise risk management and applicable regulatory frameworks. Supporting compliance with risk management related regulatory guidelines and BASEL requirements.
* Country Operational Risk oversight role including responsibilities guidance and support to local team, RCSA design, sample testing and monitoring implementation, bridging between ORM\- HO and Branch, escalation to HO ORM, trainings etc.
* Oversee Bahrain credit bureau related review, support and follow up for issue resolutions.
* Oversee Mashreq Bahrain risk indicators implementation and support audit readiness. Keep the Risk Committee/ Designated Committee(s) and Senior Management apprised of the assumptions used in and potential shortcomings of the Bank risk models and analysis.
* Ensure that:



 i. Risk reporting to the Risk Committee/ Designated Committee(s) is carefully designed to convey bank\-wide, individual portfolio and other risks in a concise and meaningful manner for designated areas in accordance with HO Risk guidelines/ policies. While reporting, must accurately communicate risk exposures and results of stress tests or scenario analyses and must provoke a robust discussion.
 



 ii. Material risk\-related ad\-hoc information that requires immediate decisions or reactions is promptly presented to Senior Management/ HO Risk and, as appropriate, the Risk Committee/ Designated Committee(s), the responsible officers and, where applicable, the Heads of Control Functions so that suitable measures and activities can be initiated at an early stage
 



**ESG Coordinator** 



* Focal point of coordination for ESG related matters for branches supporting central ESG team for associated regulatory submissions and disclosures for home and host countries.
* Training and awareness for first line of defense to ensure ESG and climate risk related data integration coordination with central function for branches including but not limited to Obligors, third parties, suppliers etc.
* Liaising on climate risk related initiatives for the branches with relevant central teams.
* Supporting central function in formulation of ESG including but not limited to climate risk related policy and procedural aspects for branches.
* Implementation support of ESG, sustainable finance and climate risk related solutions and systems for branches.
* Participation in overall ESG governance as applicable/ Responsible to cover relevant requirements in line CBB ESG Module (CBB Rulebook – Common Volume)
* Second Line of Defense responsibility for ESG risk and relevant ESG regulations across home and host countries, including alignment with Group frameworks



  





 Knowlege,Skills and Experience
 



  




* At least fifteen years of risk management experience, out of which minimum of five years should be in related areas
* Good knowledge of International and Bahrain Regulatory environment
* Expertise with ESG and Climate Risk frameworks
* Strong analytical skills and knowledge on Financial Risk Management
* Professional Risk management Qualification incl. Professional Certification would be a distinct advantage e.g. CFA / FRM/ IRM/ PRM/ SCR (Sustainability \& Climate Risk)
* Excellent computer skills (especially MS office, PPT \& Excel)



 Team player, self\-starter, innovative and highly motivated.

data.jd_text:
**This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Chief of Staff in Saudi Arabia.**
 This is a high\-impact strategic role designed for a highly analytical and execution\-focused professional who thrives at the center of fast\-moving business operations. Working closely with senior leadership, you will help drive company\-wide alignment, operational excellence, and strategic execution across multiple business functions. The role combines executive partnership, cross\-functional coordination, and operational leadership, offering direct exposure to key business decisions and high\-priority initiatives. You will help transform ideas into action, manage critical projects, support executive communication, and ensure organizational priorities stay on track in a dynamic remote\-first environment. Ideal candidates are exceptional communicators, highly organized problem\-solvers, and comfortable navigating ambiguity while balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution. This opportunity offers significant visibility, ownership, and the chance to influence the growth and scalability of a rapidly evolving global technology business.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Partner closely with executive leadership to drive strategic initiatives, operational priorities, and cross\-functional projects from planning through execution.
* Support the executive office by ensuring decisions translate into actionable next steps, clear ownership, accountability, and timely follow\-through across teams.
* Lead and coordinate high\-impact special projects, including strategic reviews, internal transformation initiatives, executive reporting, and board preparation activities.
* Develop executive\-level communications and materials such as business reviews, board presentations, company\-wide updates, and leadership reports.
* Manage and optimize the company’s operating cadence, including leadership meetings, quarterly planning cycles, OKR tracking, and business performance reviews.

* Support the adoption and integration of AI tools and workflows across teams by tracking implementation progress and identifying operational improvements.
* Serve as a strategic connector between product, engineering, commercial, and operational functions to ensure efficient coordination and execution across the organization.

* Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actionable insights.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience preparing executive presentations, reports, and business narratives.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while operating effectively in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
* Strong organizational and project management capabilities with a demonstrated ability to execute independently and deliver results with minimal oversight.
* Advanced proficiency in spreadsheet analysis, PowerPoint presentations, financial modeling, and data interpretation; SQL knowledge is considered a plus.
* Familiarity with AI tools, workflow automation, and practical AI adoption strategies within business operations is highly desirable.
* High level of discretion, judgment, and professionalism when handling sensitive organizational or commercial information.
* Intellectual curiosity and adaptability with the ability to switch seamlessly between strategic, operational, financial, and technical topics.
* Previous experience within B2B SaaS, fintech, payments infrastructure, or startup environments is advantageous.

Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Head of Local Shops to join our team and be part of our growth. If you’re a team leader who is hungry for a new adventure, a multinational workplace is waiting for you.
   

  

 As the Head of Local Shops, you will be responsible for the success of talabat in your country, create work\-class experience for customers, defining the operating procedures and KPIs.
   

  

* Strategy: Your mission will be to define strategic priorities, develop roadmaps, and make financial decisions
* Execution: You will participate in the development of the commercial strategy, operations and growth of the vertical
* Process Optimization and Management: You will have the opportunity to create and improve processes, for example managing partnerships to contribute to growth.
* You will work in close collaboration with the regional NFV, product, operations and marketing teams to implement new products and processes.
* Reconcile locals’ needs and technical capabilities to optimize our business performance
* Lead cross\-functional team alignment to make our internal and external operations more efficient and scalable
* You will own the definition of KPIs and sales targets and drive operations to meet goals
* Constantly monitor fulfillment processes and recommend improvements to increase productivity and drive total revenue
* Understand the needs of stakeholders with competing priorities, while delivering solutions that satisfy both mutually
* Set a clear mission for your team and deploy strategies focused to meet these goals.
* Taking the company’s vision and interpreting this to the local market, ensuring we’re constantly evolving, innovating, and prioritizing the right projects to meet business needs.
* Collaborating with the product, regional departments – working with all the supporting departments to ensure your market has their needs catered for, and are coordinated with upcoming changes to product, processes, and strategy.


**Qualifications**
* You have at least 7 years of experience in relevant role
* You have significant experience in management and project management and you know how to define a strategy at a local level
* You feel comfortable in a rapidly changing environment.
* You are able to make decisions with through analysis
* You are able to move quickly from long\-term thinking to immediate action.
* You are very adaptable to change and have the ability to execute quickly.
* You have excellent interpersonal skills and are able to collaborate with a variety of interlocutors, both internal and external
* You work in full autonomy and also collaborate with stakeholders, you are curious and eager to learn more about all aspects of talabat and its industry to acquire skills and knowledge very quickly and become a field expert.

data.jd_text:
**Job Title: Project Director** 




  





  





***Role Purpose***




  






 Sumou Global Investment / SGI is seeking an experienced Project Director to lead the client\-side development and delivery of assigned real estate projects across residential, commercial, hospitality, mixed\-use, master planning, infrastructure, and other asset classes. The role is responsible for aligning consultants, contractors, operators, authorities, internal teams, and stakeholders with SGI's approved business case, budget, programme, governance requirements, and long\-term asset objectives.
 




  





***Key Responsibilities***




  




* Lead the overall project direction from a client\-side perspective and ensure alignment with SGI objectives, approved business case, budget, programme, and governance requirements.
* Manage and coordinate consultants, designers, contractors, cost consultants, supervision teams, authorities, operators, and other project stakeholders.
* Oversee project development, design progress, authority approvals, procurement strategy, delivery planning, construction oversight, and handover readiness.
* Establish clear project governance, including reporting routines, action trackers, decision logs, risk registers, issue logs, approval trackers, and executive dashboards.
* Review and challenge consultant and contractor deliverables to ensure quality, completeness, coordination, compliance, cost alignment, and buildability.
* Coordinate with cost and commercial teams to monitor budgets, forecasts, commitments, value engineering, claims, variations, and key financial risks.
* Monitor milestones, identify delays, escalate critical issues, drive timely decisions, and represent SGI in senior\-level meetings with project stakeholders.
* Prepare concise executive reports covering progress, risks, decisions required, budget implications, authority status, and overall project performance.



  





***Required Qualifications \& Experience***




  




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, Real Estate Development, or a related field; master's degree is preferred.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, RICS, CIOB, or equivalent are considered an advantage; Saudi Council of Engineers registration is preferred where applicable.
* Minimum 15 years of professional experience in real estate development, project delivery, construction, design management, or large\-scale project management.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role such as Project Director, Senior Project Manager, Development Manager, or equivalent client\-side position.
* Proven experience managing major real estate projects such as residential, commercial, hospitality, mixed\-use, infrastructure, or master\-planned developments.
* Strong experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC is highly preferred, particularly in authority approvals, consultant management, procurement, and stakeholder coordination.



  





***Key Competencies***




  




* Strong client\-side leadership with solid understanding of design, construction, cost, programme, procurement, authorities, and stakeholder management.
* Ability to challenge consultants and contractors, identify gaps, manage risks, and convert complex issues into clear executive recommendations.
* Strong commercial awareness, negotiation, reporting, decision\-making, problem\-solving, and escalation management skills.
* Ability to work under fast\-track timelines and manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.



  





***Preferred Candidate Profile***




  






 The ideal candidate is not only a traditional project manager, but a senior development and delivery leader who understands how project decisions impact cost, programme, approvals, market positioning, feasibility, and long\-term asset value. The candidate should be comfortable operating at executive level while also being capable of diving into technical, commercial, and delivery details when required.

data.jd_text:
**Job Title: Project Director – Master Planning \& Infrastructure** 














***Role Purpose***




  





 To lead the client\-side management of a large\-scale master planning and infrastructure\-led development, from planning and design coordination through authority approvals, infrastructure strategy, phasing, cost alignment, and implementation readiness. The role requires a senior leader who can manage consultants, challenge technical outputs, coordinate stakeholders, and translate complex design and infrastructure matters into clear executive decisions.
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***




  




* Lead overall project direction, governance, reporting, risk management, decision logs, action trackers, and executive updates.
* Manage master planning workstreams including land use, zoning, plot subdivision, circulation, public realm, urban design framework, development controls, and phasing strategy.
* Oversee infrastructure planning and technical coordination for roads, transport, water, wastewater, stormwater, drainage, power, substations, telecom, ICT, smart city provisions, utility corridors, and underground services coordination.
* Review consultant deliverables for quality, completeness, technical coordination, commercial viability, authority compliance, and alignment with development objectives.
* Lead authority approval strategy, regulatory compliance matrix, submission programme, NOCs, permits, and coordination with relevant governmental and utility authorities.
* Coordinate infrastructure cost estimates, BOQs, CAPEX phasing, value engineering opportunities, and key commercial risks affecting feasibility and delivery.
* Ensure proper use of BIM, GIS, Civil 3D, document control, CDE workflows, design coordination, clash detection, and digital information management.
* Manage interfaces between master planning, infrastructure, public realm, mobility, utilities, sustainability, construction readiness, and stakeholder requirements.



  





  





***Required Qualifications \& Experience***




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Urban Planning, Architecture, Infrastructure Engineering, or related discipline. Master’s degree is preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience, including senior leadership roles on large\-scale master planning, infrastructure, mixed\-use, or urban development projects.
* Proven experience in client\-side project leadership, design management, consultant management, authority approvals, and infrastructure delivery coordination.
* Strong exposure to KSA/GCC projects and familiarity with Saudi regulations, municipal procedures, utility authorities, and approval pathways is highly preferred.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, RICS, CIOB, AICP, RTPI, Saudi Council of Engineers, or equivalent are an advantage.



  





***Core Technical Experience***




  




* Urban master planning and development control
* Wet and dry utilities infrastructure planning
* Authority approvals, permits, NOCs and compliance matrices
* BIM / GIS / Civil 3D coordination and clash review
* Roads, mobility, traffic and public realm coordination
* Stormwater, drainage and environmental interfaces
* Consultant, contractor and stakeholder management
* Infrastructure phasing, cost planning and value engineering



  





***Key Competencies***




  





 Strategic leadership; strong infrastructure and master planning judgement; ability to challenge consultants; commercial awareness; authority and stakeholder management; clear executive communication; fast\-track delivery mindset; problem solving; decision\-making; and strong ownership of programme, cost, quality, risk and compliance.
 



  





***Key Performance Indicators***




  





 Timely delivery of master planning, infrastructure and authority submission milestones.
 



 Quality and completeness of consultant deliverables before executive approval or authority submission.
 



 Effective mitigation of approval, infrastructure capacity, cost, phasing and design\-interface risks.
 



 Clear, concise and decision\-oriented reporting to executive management.
 



  





***Preferred Candidate Profile***




  





 A senior technical\-development leader with strong infrastructure and master planning depth, not only a traditional project manager. The candidate should understand how planning decisions affect infrastructure cost, phasing, approvals, land value, development feasibility and implementation readiness.

data.jd_text:
**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**Qualifications and Skills**



* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

data.jd_text:
Havelock One Interiors is looking for an experienced “Design \& Technical Manager – FF\&E and Joinery” to join our team in the Kingdom of Bahrain.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The role will be in the setting out department and will mainly comprise project management and oversight of manufacturing packages for bespoke and hospitality projects. The person will be at the heart of projects, ensuring seamless coordination between external and internal clients. The role is pivotal in managing and maintaining client satisfaction while balancing quality and cost performance.
   

  

 The role will support divisional performance to continuously enhance our service to our clients and support efficiency improvement to maintain competitiveness and increase business activity. Support the functional head in planning of the setting out activities, prioritizing deliveries in line with strategic plan. Overseeing day to day management and planning of setting out resources and processes to attend to commitments with an objective of continuous improvement in process efficiency. Communication is key in this role and right person will be a natural communicator able to collaborate, build professional relationships and communicate effectively across functional departments and externally to manage and lead the needs of projects.
   

  

**Role Description**
* Effective Management: Oversee assigned projects, ensuring efficient execution and adherence to timelines
* Guidance and Coordination: Guide the setting out team through the execution strategy, material submissions, procurement, shop drawings, prototyping, and manufacturing delivery
* Client Expectations: Manage project schedules, review shop drawings, understand and address client expectations
* Material Management: Check material details, obtain clearance for variations, and oversee material procurement
* Technical Insight: Interpret project specifications, identify material requirements, and provide technical guidance
* Process Efficiency: Continuously improve processes for better efficiency, identify, implement, and support initiatives that yield continuous improvement
* Communication: Be a natural and effective communicator. Collaborate with internal teams and clients to lead, manage, and coordinate project needs


**Candidate Requirements**
* Experience: Minimum of ten to fifteen years in a manufacturing setup
* Suitable qualification either from an interiors background, technical or similar discipline
* Joinery Expertise: Track record in joinery setting out detailing, planning, influencing, site execution strategy, shop drawings, cutting lists, and material take\-offs
* Materials Knowledge: Familiarity with common joinery and interior materials, surfaces etc (timber, boards, veneers, laminates, hardware, special surfaces, transitions etc)
* Technical Acumen: Strong problem\-solving skills related to materials integration (glass, acrylics, stone, metals, fabrics)
* Software Proficiency: Well\-versed in Autodesk products and Microsoft Office applications, progressive and be a catalyst in adoption of digitization, 3D software capabilities
* Industry Standards: Familiarity with FSC, LEED requirements, and FR standards
* Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills for successful collaboration in a multinational environment
* Innovation leader: Capable of being strategic and identifying strengths and weaknesses and adopting strategies for continuous improvement


 We are looking forward to receiving your application for the position of “Design \& Technical Manager – FF\&E and Joinery” in the Kingdom of Bahrain in case you meet the above\-mentioned criteria.
   

  

 Shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Airport Design Manager will lead and manage all design activities for the airport project under the Project Management Consultant (PMC). The role ensures that designs are coordinated, compliant, and delivered on time, aligning with project objectives, budget, and international standards while integrating all disciplines effectively.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage the overall design process across all disciplines, including civil, structural, architectural, MEP, and special airport systems.
* Knowledge for the implementation of IATA ADRM, GACA 139, IBC (also Saudi Codes and Regulations), and NFPA.
* Develop and implement design management plans, schedules, and deliverables tracking.
* Coordinate with design consultants to ensure timely submission and approval of design documents.
* Review and validate design deliverables to ensure compliance with project requirements, codes, and standards.
* Ensure proper integration and coordination between multidisciplinary design components.
* Identify design risks, clashes, and inconsistencies, and ensure timely resolution.
* Manage design changes and ensure proper documentation and approval processes are followed.
* Liaise with stakeholders, including clients, authorities, operators, and contractors, for design approvals.
* Support value engineering initiatives to optimize design efficiency, cost, and constructability.
* Lead design coordination meetings and provide technical direction to the project team.
* Informs themselves of the relevant Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures in place within Hill International, and ensures continued compliance with these requirements while employed by Hill.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Project Director or line manager.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Architecture (Master’s degree preferred).
* Minimum 15 years’ relevant experience in Airport/Aviation projects, including space utilization, concept design, IBC (also Saudi Codes and Regulations), GACA 139, NFPA, and IATA ADRM, and able to draft the scope of works and specifications.
* Thorough knowledge of airport landside and Passenger Terminal operations
* Effectively uncover client needs and provide compelling solutions.
* Thoroughly perform site inventories.
* Stakeholder management and consultation
* Efficiently create uniquely desirable, artistic, and inspirational designs.
* Accurately prepare construction drawings and take\-offs.
* Demonstrate and maintain a high knowledge of landscape trends, features, and techniques.
* Undertake a design project from concept to completion.
* Define project requirements and schedule during the “brief”.
* Interpret and translate customer needs into rough plans.
* Set costs and project fees according to the budget.
* Ability to work well under pressure and tight deadlines.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills


**About Us**
 Hill International, with more than 4,300\+ professionals in over 100 offices worldwide, provides program management, project management, construction management, project management oversight, advisory, facilities management, and other consulting services to clients in a variety of market sectors. Engineering News\-Record magazine recently ranked Hill as one of the largest program management firms in the world. **A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of executing service orders for the compression fleet, driving meaningful projects that enhance operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Your role will involve strategic planning and coordination, ensuring that projects are delivered within scope, time, quality, and budget, thereby contributing significantly to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a dynamic team environment that values collaboration, innovation, and proactive communication, fostering a culture of growth and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Execute compression service orders, including parts, repairs, field service, and complete outage projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Manage customer relationships during order execution, acting as their advocate within the organization and enhancing communication across service offerings.
* Organize and lead teams, define responsibilities, develop schedules, and allocate resources to address specific project challenges effectively.
* Extend service order management to the Middle Eastern region as needed, ensuring seamless execution and delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to achieve revenue, EBIT, on\-time delivery, and project delivery targets, while driving client satisfaction and supporting cash collection.
* Collaborate with finance for accurate forecasting and coordinate with global teams to align service order execution with global standards.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, or a related field, with 4\-6 years of relevant experience in project management, preferably in the Oil \& Gas industry or with rotating equipment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to develop and implement strategic plans effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with project management and order management tools and concepts.
* Self\-driven and adaptable, with a positive attitude and the ability to solve challenges collaboratively.
* Familiarity with CRM (Salesforce) and ERP software (e.g., SAP) is highly desirable, enhancing operational efficiency.
* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills, with strong leadership abilities to influence stakeholders and drive project success.


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

+ Assigned Products Closures: GD Engineering

The Job Holder will also prepare and present sales presentations, sales forecasts and action plans in order to maximise the market potential and will develop goals accordingly to achieve the specified sales and business development targets.
   

  

**Principal Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Sell and promote Celeros Flow Technology assigned aftermarket on spares, upgrades and service solutions in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain (End users, service contractors, engineering consultants) or via Local Agents / Distributors (where applicable).

When engaging with a new Local Agent / Distributor ensure the due diligence documents should be completed and submitted in a timely manner to the Legal Department for approval. Continue to manage and support the Local Agents / Distributors – provide technical and commercial support, provide training and guidance, make joint visits to key Customers as necessary, set KPI’s, monitor and evaluate performance, provide feedback / escalate as necessary through weekly meetings and quarterly reviews.
* Demonstrate strong expertise for assigned products and for the industry.
* Develop and expand relationships with existing and potential Customers and maintain close relationships with key Customers through driving spares price agreements with key accounts.
* Communicate regularly and consistently with existing and potential Customers to generate leads and opportunities and maximize aftermarket entitlement of the installed base.
* Appraise Customer’s current and future needs and advise on the appropriate Celeros Flow Technology products and services to meet their requirements and propose alternative solutions as necessary.
* Follow up with Customers to ensure Celeros Flow Technology products and services are meeting their requirements and expectations.
* Investigate and coordinate the resolution of complaints raised by Customers and troubleshoot their concerns.
* Interface with Customers and conduct on\-site meetings as necessary to understand requirements, to obtain order commitment, to finalise designs and to resolve concerns / complaints.
* Collaborate with other Regional Product Sales Managers, sharing information and business opportunities.
* Coordinate with Field Service Engineers to win Customer maintenance contracts where appropriate.
* Support Field Service Engineers and conduct joint site visits to facilitate work and training activities.
* Proactively react to Customers RFQ’s (request for quotation). secure the necessary internal approval to proceed with a quotation. Effectively communicates to the Customer the intention to provide a quotation, or not. Updates the CRM or equivalent tool accordingly.

Analyze the requirements in line with data sheets, specifications, P\&IDs, plans, and other project specific documents. Design, size and select suitable products as per the Customers requirements and support the Application Engineering Team to develop an appropriate proposal / quotation.

* Organise and drive the preparation of bids and contracts.
* Coordinate with the Finance / Accounts team and be aware of and problems with Supplier and Customer accounts.
* Coordinate and actively participate in the order hand over meeting with the Manufacturing Facility, Project Manager and Supply Chain Team. Provide clarification on any specific project requirements and on any technical or commercial queries.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, review the market potential for assigned products in the assigned territories and compile a strategy and action plan in order to maximize market potential and achieve targets. Continue to develop and recommend innovative ideas and tactics to increase market share and increase sales.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, evaluate and determine optimum route to market, including a pricing and marketing strategy and identify suitable partnership Companies to sell Celeros Flow Technology products and services.
* Execute agreed action plans to achieve targets for assigned products in the assigned territories.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity in the assigned region on a regular basis. Report any concerns and suggested solutions and any opportunities and suggested action plans to the Line Manager / Regional Director.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports (forecast, customer visit report, etc.) showing sales volume including potential sales, monitored against the budget, with action plans to address variations.
* Prepare and deliver sales presentations and technical presentations to internal and external stakeholders.
* Participate in trade shows, exhibitions and seminars either directly or in conjunction with Local Agents / Distributors.
* Represent the Company in a professional manner aligned to the Celeros Flow Technology Values and ensure all activities comply with both legal and ethical standards.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Thinks both creatively and commercially; has in\-depth engineering knowledge to identify technical risks, solve problems and provide solutions but also has in\-depth commercial knowledge to identify risks within contracts.
* Analyses and interprets common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Must be able to define the problem, assess the risks, and develop recommendations for action plans. Furthermore, must be able to execute the action plan, focus and guide others to accomplish the plan and drive change where necessary.
* Encourages others to seek opportunities for different and innovative approaches to addressing problems and opportunities; facilitates the implementation and acceptance of change within the workplace.
* Displays exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, even when handling multiple demands and has a proven track record of meeting high performance standards.
* Responds professionally to all inquiries and complaints and remains calm and composed when under pressure.
* Communicates effectively, effortlessly tailoring the approach to the audience and the level of technical competence.
* Possesses the ability to prepare and deliver both sales and technical presentations and to train and transfer technical knowledge to internal and external stakeholders.
* Clearly and succinctly conveying information and ideas to individuals and groups in a variety of situations; communicating in a focused and compelling way that drives others’ thoughts and actions. Engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.
* Uses appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance of ideas and plans; modifying one’s own behaviour to accommodate tasks, situations, and individuals involved.
* Exhibits confidence with negotiations and possesses the power to influence.

**IT Project Manager** 




  





 Join a growing IT Project Management function within a well\-established insurance organisation undergoing major digital transformation across customer experience, operations, integrations, and internal systems.

The environment is fast\-moving, collaborative, and still evolving, so this role would suit someone who enjoys solving problems, coordinating people, and bringing clarity to complex projects.
 



  





**The Role:** 




 You’ll work closely with business users, technical teams, vendors, and senior stakeholders to manage projects from initiation through to delivery. Projects may range across applications, integrations, digital platforms, customer experience initiatives, infrastructure, data, and operational improvements.
 



  





 The IT Project Management function is still relatively new, so this is also an opportunity to contribute to how projects are managed across the organisation moving forward.
 



  





 This role suits someone pragmatic, organised, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple concurrent projects at different stages of delivery.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing:** 




 • Managing end\-to\-end IT and digital projects across the organisation.
 



 • Defining scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and resource requirements.
 



 • Coordinating cross\-functional teams across business and technical functions.
 



 • Working closely with stakeholders to gather requirements and keep projects aligned to business objectives.
 



 • Managing vendors, third\-party providers, and implementation partners.
 



 • Identifying risks, blockers, and delivery challenges early and helping drive resolutions.
 



 • Supporting and improving project governance, documentation, workflows, and delivery processes.
 



 • Tracking project progress through Jira, MS Project, or similar tools.
 



 • Preparing project updates and status reporting for leadership and stakeholders.
 



 • Helping introduce and mature project management best practices across the organisation.

 • 3–5 years of experience managing IT, technology, or digital projects.
 



 • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders across technical and non\-technical teams.
 



 • Strong communication and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Good understanding of Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
 



 • Experience with project management tools such as Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or similar.
 



 • Comfortable working across both applications and infrastructure\-related projects.
 



 • Experience working with integrations, APIs, migrations, SaaS platforms, or digital transformation initiatives is beneficial.
 



 • Background within insurance, banking, telecoms, MSPs, or other regulated/service\-led environments would be advantageous.
 



 • PMP or similar certification is a plus.
 



 • Arabic fluency would be a ideal.
 



  





**What’s in It for You:** 




 • Opportunity to join a business actively investing in digital transformation
 



 • Exposure to a broad mix of business\-critical technology initiatives
 



 • A chance to help shape and improve delivery processes within a growing PMO function
 



 • High visibility across business and technology teams
 



 • A collaborative environment with strong leadership support for improving project delivery
 



  





**Next Steps:** 




 If you’re currently managing technology projects and want a role where you can have real influence on delivery, process improvement, and business outcomes, this could be a strong opportunity.
 



  





 Send your CV or get in touch in confidence to learn more.

Bilfinger is a leading international industrial services provider, driving efficiency and sustainability for the process industry. With 30,000\+ employees and over €5 billion in revenue in 2024, we offer solutions in consulting, engineering, manufacturing, maintenance, turnarounds, and digital applications across key sectors like energy, chemicals, pharma, and oil \& gas.
   

  

 In the Middle East, Bilfinger provides comprehensive services ranging from feasibility studies, conceptual and detailed design, to project management and construction supervision. We play a vital role in oil \& gas, power, water, infrastructure, and industrial sectors by ensuring projects meet international standards, cost efficiency, and sustainability goals. Beyond project delivery, we also support clients with asset integrity management, plant maintenance, and turnaround services to ensure reliability, efficiency, and extended lifecycle of critical facilities.
   

  

 With deep regional expertise of around 3600\+ employees and global best practices, we support our clients in achieving operational excellence, risk management, and long\-term value creation.
   

  

 At Bilfinger, we offer a work environment where you can learn and grow. Join us and be part of a team shaping the future!
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 This role is primarily focused on project coordination, integration oversight, and stakeholder management rather than detailed system design.
   

  

 The role requires prior hands\-on involvement in delivering end\-to\-end dispatching system implementation (gas, energy, pipeline, or similar real\-time operational control systems), including coordination with multiple vendors, control/IT/OT systems, and operations teams.
   

  

**Project Delivery \& Execution**
* Coordinate the full project lifecycle: FEED → detailed engineering → procurement → implementation → commissioning → handover.
* Coordinate to deliver functional modules for gas dispatching system including real‑time monitoring, nomination management, demand forecasting, priority‑based allocation, curtailment logic, LNG scheduling, and GIS/pipeline surveillance.


**Internal Stakeholder Management**
* Coordinate with internal teams: Operations, Gas Planning, Midstream Gas, LNG Import, Instrumentation, IT/OT, Project Services.
* Align project requirements with operational needs and owner department expectations.
* Facilitate cross‑discipline reviews and technical approvals.


**Vendor \& EPC Coordination**
* Manage vendors, dispatch system suppliers, and EPC teams executing gas dispatching upgrades.
* Drive interface management, technical clarifications, system architecture reviews, and integration testing.


**Quality, Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure compliance with OT cybersecurity requirements and engineering standards.
* Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies in line with GDN project challenges.


**Systems Integration Coordination**
* Coordinate and oversee system integration activities in consultation with relevant technical teams.
* Coordinate in consultation with company IT/Business application team to validate cybersecurity, data integrity, and system reliability.
* Coordinate with all technical support teams to arrange approvals of system workflows, and data mapping as per project needs.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Process, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial Engineering, Telecommunication, Instrumentation, Automation, Mechanical/Piping Engineering or equivalent.
* 8 to 10 years’ experience in project management and coordination.
* Experience in handling gas dispatching system project will be an advantage including proven execution of gas or energy dispatching systems.
* Candidates must have previously worked on at least one gas dispatching system platforms through configuration, system integration, testing, commissioning, and handover to operations
* Proven experience delivering large multi‑vendor, multidiscipline complex projects.
* Strong technical coordination and stakeholder management skills.


**Key Skills**
* Project management and coordination
* Understanding of gas dispatching, gas planning, or pipeline operations in an oil \& gas environment
* Stakeholder \& Vendor Management


 For additional information please contact Gelson Dsouza, email gelson.dsouza@bilfinger.com.
   

  

 Bilfinger is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 If you are interested in an employment with Bilfinger, please submit your application in the safe environment of our global job portal only using the "apply now" button.

At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
   

  

**Reimagine What’s Possible**
 Rotoflow™, an Air Products Business, is a full\-service turbomachinery OEM \- providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and services to our customers globally in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Aftermarket services such as spare parts, repairs, upgrades, field services, engineering evaluations, reliability and performance assessments, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, and shop services are some of the many offerings provided from regional service centers for both Air Products and non\-Air Products equipment.
   

  

 We are seeking an
 **Rotoflow** 
**Aftermarket Project Manager** 
 at our turbomachinery service center in KSA\- DSC, responsible for providing projects execution with engineering support for spare parts, repairs, upgrades, reverse engineering, and field service of all types of turbomachinery.
   

  

**You Will Enjoy**
* Be part of a team to grow a world\-class service and machinery business.
* Seeing the results of candidate’s direct efforts through successful execution of customer projects.
* Being empowered to satisfy customers and have influence on changes to work processes to meet customer expectations on speed and world\-class customer service.
* Collaborating with a cross\-functional team across commercial, engineering, procurement and manufacturing on a wide variety of projects with varying technical complexity and scope.
* Significant direct interaction with customers, in coordination with account managers, ensures Rotoflow exceeds customer expectations with solutions.
* Ability to grow and develop one’s career and take on increasing responsibility.


**Responsibilities**
* Work collaboratively with Proposal Managers to receive assigned orders, develop and implement appropriate execution plans that address execution, budget, and schedule, and put in place a team that can successfully execute.
* Manage and execute orders and projects concurrently in different phases, from order intake, execution, shipment, invoicing, and accounts receivable.

* Lead and guide the execution team and provide directions on objective priorities to ensure tasks and deliverables are completed as planned.
* Manage changes on projects to keep projects on track and meet financial and customer targets.
* Provide feedback on lessons learned during execution to other functions to assure continuous improvement.


**Qualifications And Requirements**
* Technical Degree (BA/BS/BEng); mechanical/ Industrial engineering background a plus,
* Project Management Experience, \> 5 years is preferred, with excellent written and oral communication skills and demonstrated ability to effectively lead and organize engineering teams and handle multiple projects simultaneously.

* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP is beneficial
* Detailed knowledge of rotating equipment's / turbomachinery, accessory systems, and related technologies and services is a plus.
* Goal oriented, self\-motivated, highly organized, with ability to drive success, with strong winning spirit and ability to motivate teams.
* Excellent creativity, problem solving, and decision\-making skills \- including an understanding of when to escalate both technical and administrative decisions.
* Aptitude and desire to quickly learn.
* Excellent time management skills.
* Ability and drive to continuously improve and eliminate unnecessary barriers or complexity to meeting customer needs
* Ability to create an environment of trust and consistently exhibit a positive attitude.


 We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end\-to\-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.
   

  

 At Air Products, we work in an environment where we put safety first, diversity is essential, inclusion is our culture, and each person knows they belong and matter. To learn more, visit About Air Products.

**Overview:** 




  





 As the Individual and Unit Coach at Al\-Qadsiah Club, you will specialise in developing the technical abilities and individual behaviours of Academy players across multiple age groups. You will play a key role in delivering individual development programmes aligned with the club’s game model, supporting both player progression and overall team performance.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Leadership and Management** 




  




* Collaborate with the Head of Individual Development to deliver the Academy’s Individual Development Model
* Support the planning and delivery of monthly training programmes across age groups with clear development objectives
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of individual development practices within the Academy



  





**Individual Development and Coaching** 




  




* Deliver high\-quality individual and small group coaching sessions focused on technical development and behaviour
* Design and deliver position\-specific and unit\-based training aligned to the Qadsiah Game Model
* Support players across all Academy age groups (U13–U21\) in their individual development journeys
* Provide targeted feedback during team training sessions to support individual player progression



  





**Analysis and Performance Support** 




  




* Lead the design and delivery of video analysis sessions for individual and small group development
* Maintain and develop a library of training sessions and best practice content using club platforms (IterPro, Hudl, SportsCode)
* Collaborate with the Performance Analysis department to enhance player development resources



  





**Collaboration and Player Development** 




  




* Contribute to Individual Development Plans and player performance reviews
* Work closely with multidisciplinary staff across the Academy to support holistic player development
* Engage with coaching staff to ensure alignment between individual and team objectives

**Desirable:** 




  




* AFC Pro License or UEFA equivalent
* FIFA Guardian safeguarding qualification
* Skills, Knowledge and Experience:



  





**Essential**

* AFC A License or UEFA equivalent
* Proven experience coaching elite academy players
* Strong understanding of individual player development across different age groups
* Ability to deliver structured and targeted individual coaching sessions
* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams
* Strong communication skills and ability to engage players effectively
* Proactive and structured approach to problem\-solving
* Comfortable working within a new cultural and professional environment
* Fluency in English



  





**Desirable:** 




  




* Experience using performance and analysis platforms such as IterPro, Hudl, and SportsCode
* Multilingual capability, including Arabic or Spanish
* Previous experience as a professional footballer Experience working in the Middle East
* Strong leadership and teamwork experience



  





  





**Why Join Al\-Qadsiah?** 




  





 Be Part of the Legacy: Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





 Experience the Culture: Thrive in an environment that values quality, accountability, diversity, synergy, innovation, and ambition, while embracing harmony—this is the Qadsiah Way.
 



  





 The Executives in Sport Group are retained on behalf of Al Qadsiah SC to make this appointment. All direct applications and CVs will be forwarded to The Executives in Sport Group.
 



  





**If this role is of interest, then please press the apply button and include a copy of your CV.**
