Job Purpose:
 



 To lead and direct Asyad Logistics’ Freight Forwarding business in Oman, ensuring profitable growth, commercial expansion, operational excellence, and strong financial control across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance activities. The role carries full P\&L accountability for the Freight Forwarding business, with responsibility for driving revenue growth, margin improvement, service quality, business transformation, and disciplined working capital management including timely billing, collections, and cash flow performance. The role supports Oman’s positioning as a regional logistics hub while ensuring compliance with ASYAD Group standards, OIA governance, Oman Labour Law, customs regulations, and international trade requirements.
 



  





 Main Accountabilities and Responsibilities:
 


* Develop and execute the Freight Forwarding strategy, annual business plan, and budget in alignment with Asyad Logistics’ growth ambitions and national logistics objectives.
* Drive commercial expansion by winning new business, penetrating target sectors, strengthening customer relationships, and building a healthy pipeline across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance services.
* Identify and develop new products, trade lanes, customer segments, and value\-added forwarding solutions that enhance revenue, competitiveness, and market share.
* Build and strengthen strategic relationships with airlines, shipping lines, overseas agents, transport partners, customs stakeholders, and key government entities to improve capability, reach, and commercial positioning.
* Lead the Freight Forwarding business to support Oman’s role as a competitive regional gateway and logistics hub.
* Ensure all strategic initiatives and business activities are aligned with ASYAD Group standards, OIA governance requirements, and relevant regulatory frameworks.
* Hold full P\&L accountability for the Freight Forwarding business, ensuring sustainable revenue growth, margin improvement, cost discipline, and delivery of agreed financial targets.
* Lead end\-to\-end Freight Forwarding operations across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance to ensure service reliability, operational excellence, compliance, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive pricing discipline, job profitability, vendor cost control, and operational efficiency to improve gross margin and EBIT performance.
* Ensure strong financial leadership across the business through timely and accurate billing, reduction of revenue leakage, disciplined credit control, proactive collections follow\-up, and close monitoring of overdue receivables and cash conversion.
* Oversee operational and commercial controls to ensure timely job closure, complete cost capture, accurate invoicing, and proper handover to finance.
* Manage key cost drivers including transport procurement, vendor agreements, subcontracted services, manpower, claims exposure, and service failures.
* Ensure full compliance with customs rules, international trade regulations, internal governance requirements, and health, safety, security, and quality standards.
* Maintain service excellence and resilience across the forwarding network while ensuring competitiveness in rates, transit times, and customer responsiveness.
* Lead business improvement initiatives to simplify processes, strengthen controls, improve visibility, and raise productivity across commercial and operational functions.
* Drive transformation in areas such as digital forwarding, performance dashboards, shipment visibility, pricing governance, job costing discipline, and exception management.
* Implement performance measurement frameworks that track revenue growth, gross profit, yield, billing timeliness, collections, DSO, productivity, service quality, and customer retention.
* Improve the effectiveness of the commercial and operational interface to ensure faster quotation turnaround, better conversion, smoother execution, and stronger customer experience.
* Identify structural opportunities to improve business performance, including trade lane prioritization, customer profitability management, vendor consolidation, and operating model enhancement.
* Strengthen governance, risk management, and compliance processes within Freight Forwarding operations to protect profitability and reduce operational and financial leakage.
* Lead and develop the Freight Forwarding organization, including commercial, customer service, operations, customs clearance, and support teams.
* Build a high\-performance culture centered on accountability, customer focus, commercial discipline, execution quality, and continuous improvement.
* Develop organizational capability through coaching, succession planning, performance management, and Omanization initiatives.
* Set clear performance expectations for revenue generation, profitability, billing discipline, collections support, operational delivery, and customer satisfaction.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with finance, procurement, HR, IT, QHSE, and other business units to ensure strong business execution.
* Champion ethical leadership, safety, compliance, and professional standards across the Freight Forwarding business.



  





 Minimum Qualifications and Experience
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or related field.
* Preferred: Master’s degree or MBA with focus on Supply Chain/Operations.
* Professional certifications in logistics/supply chain (e.g., CSCP, FIATA, CILT) are an advantage.
* Minimum 10 years in logistics and supply chain, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Proven track record in freight forwarding, warehousing, and transport operations with full P\&L responsibility.
* Experience in developing and executing large\-scale logistics strategies and transformation projects.



 Strong understanding of GCC and international logistics markets, compliance, and trade regulations.
 



  





 Job Specific Skills:
 


* Freight Forwarding Management across Air, Sea, Road Freight, and Customs Clearance
* P\&L and Financial Management
* Commercial Leadership and Business Development
* Margin Management, Pricing Discipline, Billing, Collections, and Working Capital Control
* Operational Excellence and Cost Optimization
* Customs, Trade Compliance, and Regulatory Management
* Strategic Partnerships and Carrier / Agent Network Management
* Business Improvement and Digital Transformation
* Strong leadership and people management skills
* Strong commercial drive and financial acumen
* Strategic and results\-oriented mindset
* Excellent communication, influencing, and negotiation skills
* High resilience and adaptability in a dynamic market
* Strong ownership, accountability, and execution focus



 Collaborative, ethical, and performance\-driven leadership style

 The Director of Business Development is responsible for leading the growth and expansion of Oman Airports’ airport consultancy, PPP, concession, and O\&M business portfolio by identifying and securing strategic business opportunities across regional and international markets. The role oversees business development strategy, client engagement, bid leadership, commercial negotiations, and partnership development while driving market positioning, revenue growth, and competitive advantage. The position also leads cross\-functional teams in structuring complex aviation and infrastructure deals, managing stakeholder relationships, supporting investment evaluations, and ensuring alignment with corporate governance, strategic objectives, and long\-term business growth initiatives.
 



  





**Key ACCOUNTABILITIES** 




**1\. Strategic Business Development \& Growth** 



* Lead the identification, prioritization, and pursuit of new business opportunities across airport consultancy, PPP concessions, and O\&M contracts
* Define and execute the business development strategy aligned with the growth ambitions of Oman Airports
* Build and manage a robust pipeline of opportunities across target regions, with a focus on emerging and high\-growth aviation markets
* Drive market entry strategies, including partnerships, joint ventures, and consortium formations



**2\. Opportunity Origination \& Client Engagement** 



* Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders including governments, airport authorities, investors, and industry partners
* Proactively originate opportunities through market intelligence, networking, and strategic positioning
* Represent the organization in high\-level engagements, industry forums, and client meetings

* Oversee the end\-to\-end bid and proposal process for consultancy, PPP, and O\&M opportunities
* Provide strategic direction to the Proposal \& Bid Management team to ensure compelling, compliant, and competitive submissions
* Define win strategies, value propositions, and competitive positioning for each opportunity
* Ensure alignment between technical solutions, financial models, and commercial frameworks



**4\. PPP, O\&M \& Consultancy Deal Structuring** 



* Lead the structuring of complex PPP and concession opportunities, including commercial frameworks and risk allocation
* Guide the development of financial and commercial models in collaboration with finance teams
* Negotiate key commercial terms with clients, partners, and stakeholders
* Oversee the evaluation of investment opportunities, including strategic fit, risk profile, and expected returns



**5\. Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Team Management** 



* Lead and mentor multidisciplinary teams across business development, proposals, finance, legal, and technical functions
* Foster collaboration and alignment across internal departments to deliver integrated solutions
* Set performance targets, monitor outcomes, and drive accountability across the business development function
* Build internal capabilities in airport advisory, PPP structuring, and bid management



**6\. Market Intelligence \& Competitive Positioning** 



* Monitor global aviation trends, airport privatization programs, and competitor activities
* Provide strategic insights to senior leadership on market dynamics, risks, and opportunities

* Ensure all business development activities align with corporate governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks

**8\. Partnerships \& Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, evaluate, and onboard strategic partners, advisors, and consortium members for major bids
* Lead relationship management with key partners across PPP and consultancy engagements
* Strengthen the organization’s ecosystem to enhance competitiveness in large\-scale international tenders



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Aviation, Engineering, Business, or Economics; an MBA or equivalent advanced degree is strongly preferred.
* 10\+ years of leadership experience in airport operations, infrastructure, aviation strategy, with at least 5 years in leadership position or international role.
* Experience leading global airport concession bids, acquisitions, or major aviation infrastructure programs.
* Experience with emerging market operations, public\-private partnerships, and stakeholder engagement with governments or multilateral institutions.
* Understanding of commercial aviation services and airport ecosystems (ground services, retail, cargo, digital).

**Director of Project Management** 




  





 Majid Al Futtaim is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Project Management to lead the delivery of large\-scale residential, non\-residential, infrastructure, and landscape development projects.
 



 This leadership role will oversee the full project lifecycle — from planning and procurement through execution, handover, and post\-delivery customer experience. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, safety, and sustainability.
 



  





**PURPOSE OF THE JOB** 




  





 • The Director of Project Management reports to the Chief Development Officer and works in close partnership with the Director of Development. The Director of Project Management is responsible for the delivery of all residential, non\-residential buildings and infrastructure (civil and landscape) works for the development.
 



 • The role requires development of short and long term planning for delivery of the project business plan. Monthly forecasting and monitoring of progress of works (cost time and quality) to handover is required to ensure cash and revenue projections are achieved.
 



 • Bring together, direct and manage all PM staff, contractors and consultants with clear briefing and management for all works, demonstrating a strong presence on site as a “hands on” leader.
 



 • Control time, cost, quality and health and safety via clear direction and management tools (dashboards, programs, budgets, meetings) to ensure design intent is delivered, resulting in a positive customer experience combined with efficiency of operations.
 



 • Prioritise response to any direct requests or instructions given by Senior Shareholder representatives and ensure full resolution agreed with the Shareholder expeditiously, at all times in liaison with and sign off by the DM team of such process.
 



 • Develop Best Practice methodology in benchmarking and value engineering to ensure cost efficiency without jeopardizing initial development concepts/customer expectations at time of pre\-sales.
 



 • Review existing operations \& administrative systems \& streamline as required to optimize resource efficiency.
 



 • Prepare clear \& concise RFP’s consistent with budgets for consultant \& contractor selection process as necessary \& in liaison with DM team.
 



 • Lead \& report on WOW initiatives as relate to PM operations and Capex across development projects.
 



 • Working closely with the customer experience/FM teams and managing the aftercare team is essential to ensure a positive customer experience continues post\-handover.
 



 • Develop safety, sustainability \& innovation strategies and targets for each business plan year.
 



 • Report regularly, and with clarity and transparently at all times.
 



 • Manage internal audits to ensure that company procedures and policies are being followed and adhered to.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Key Tasks** 




 • Manage delivery of all residential, non\-residential built form and infrastructure works.
 



 • Use, and develop where necessary, key processes and procedures to ensure monitoring and management of time, cost and quality for all projects.
 



 • Work in close cooperation with the Director of Development on design of all works and ensure the delivery of design intent is achieved.
 



 • Develop and manage budget for all costs to ensure KPI’s are achieved.
 



 • Work with CDO, development and finance teams to develop business plan strategy.
 



 • Forecast and manage handover of all works to ensure Business Plan cash flow and revenue projections are achieved on, or ahead of target.
 



 • Procure all services with clear and concise briefing, pre\-qualification, negotiation and appointment in line with company policies and procedures.
 



 • Focus on cash management of works to ensure the most efficient use of company\-wide CAPEX.
 



 • Ensure strategy of handover of works to FM is comprehensive and well planned starting at the concept design stage, to ensure seamless handover resulting in a positive customer experience.
 



 • Ensure supportive relationship with Customer Experience Team to enhance the customer experience at all touch points relative to the PM function.
 



 • HSE compliance to be in line with best practice to maintain/improve track record.
 



 • Risk management framework regularly updated and managed to avoid negative impacts and ensure efficient, financially and corporate compliance via transparent, sustainable and safe operations at all time.
 



 • Ensure approvals/licenses and other obligations are procured and adhered to for all works.
 



 • Develop a meeting framework to ensure clear briefing, direction and follow up of the PM team, contractors, consultants and liaison with other in house staff to meet agreed KPIs.
 



 • Provide clear, concise and transparent reporting and communication to senior management on a monthly basis, including weekly meeting and updates to CDO.
 



 • Ensure sustainability initiatives are developed and targets adhered to for the project.
 



 • Foster innovation within the team to achieve companywide innovation targets.
 



 • Develop and foster strong relationships with key government authorities, contractors and consultants to ensure smooth management and delivery of projects.
 



 • Foster motivation and develop a collaborative team environment where the Development Management \& Project Management teams work seamlessly.
 



  





**PERSON SPECIFICATION** 




**Education \& Experience** 




 • BSc in Project Management, Engineering, or related discipline.
 



 • 15\+ years of Middle East work experience in the development field, with the majority of experience being client\-side.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  





**Functional Knowledge** 




 • Deep knowledge of built form and infrastructure within large scale/multiple project environments.
 



 • Strong understanding of development processes and procedures.
 



 • Strong understanding of customer needs and business value drivers.
 



 • Proficient in software applications such as AutoCAD, MS Project, MS Office, BIM, and related systems.
 



  





**Technical Competencies** 




 • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills.
 



 • Strong analytical skills.
 



 • Strong budgeting and future planning skills.
 



  





**Management Competencies** 




 • Leads by example.
 



 • Team player.
 



 • Strong interpersonal relationship skills.
 



 • Initiative and proactive mindset.
 



 • Diplomacy and stakeholder management.
 



  





**Communication** 




 • Effective writing and reporting skills.
 



 • Ability to deliver presentations across a variety of situations and topics.
 



 • Strong relationship development and maintenance skills.
 



 • Strong internal communication capabilities.
 



 • Fluency in English, both verbal and written, is preferred. Fluency in Arabic would be advantageous but not essential.
 



  





**Core Values** 




 • Bold
 



 • Passionate
 



 • Togetherness

data.jd_text:
CNS is a technology company that powers the future by providing digital solutions essential to support all enterprise and human development. While growing and managing a robust pool of supplier\-partners for the benefit of our clients has always been a priority, we are constantly re\-inventing ourselves.
   

  

 Founded in 1987 with more than 30 years of experience, CNS employs over 320 employees including more than 250 certified engineers. We offer in\-depth expertise and a range of best\-in\-class products that support the digital transformation of all major industries. With offices in three countries, we have an extensive reach into, and regional knowledge of the Middle East markets.
   

  

 A shift into levering our many years of experience to develop pioneering software in\-house will add yet another dimension to our highly innovative solutions\-portfolio.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Project Coordinator will support Project Managers in planning, executing, and closing projects across CNS Oman by managing schedules, documentation, reporting, and stakeholder coordination. The role involves working closely with internal teams, customers, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in line with CNS standards.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Support project managers in preparing and maintaining project plans, schedules, trackers, and status reports for CNS projects in Oman.
* Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas and minutes, record decisions and action items, and follow up to ensure timely closure.
* Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and issues, and escalate any deviations from plan to the project manager.
* Maintain up\-to\-date project documentation including scope documents, approvals, change requests, meeting notes, and progress updates in the designated repositories.
* Coordinate with internal teams (technical, service delivery, sales, procurement, finance, logistics) to support timely execution of project activities.
* Liaise with customers, vendors, and subcontractors on routine coordination matters, scheduling, document submissions, and implementation updates.
* Support procurement and logistics follow\-up for project materials, licenses, hardware, software, and third\-party services, ensuring alignment with project timelines.
* Assist with project financial administration, including monitoring purchase requests, invoices, cost records, and ensuring supporting documents are complete for billing.
* Prepare regular project dashboards and summary reports for management and stakeholders, highlighting progress, issues, and upcoming milestones.
* Support testing, handover, customer acceptance, and project closure activities, including collection of sign\-offs and preparation of lessons learned.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Professional certification such as PMP, CAPM, or PRINCE2 Foundation (or equivalent) is preferred .


**Experience**
* 3–5 years of experience in project coordination, project administration, or PMO support, preferably in IT, systems integration, or technology services.
* Experience supporting infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, software, or managed services projects in the GCC / Oman.


**Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills; excellent written and verbal communication; proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); ability to maintain trackers and reports; attention to detail; ability to manage multiple priorities; stakeholder coordination; documentation control; basic commercial awareness.
* Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Asana); understanding of project governance and change control; exposure to IT service delivery environments; basic understanding of contracts and SLAs.


**Additional Information**
*Compliance with policies and procedures based on the ISO standards adopted by CNS.*

 Purpose Context
 



 To deliver exceptional customer support, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and trust in our FinTech solutions. The role focuses on resolving customer issues efficiently, providing insightful guidance, and driving continuous improvement in service quality. This role is critical to building strong customer relationships, addressing concerns promptly, and ensuring compliance with service\-level agreements (SLAs) and industry standards.

 • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Banking, or a related field.

 • Adaptable and capable of supporting evolving fintech operational requirements.
 



 • Passionate about operational excellence, customer experience, and innovation.

* Determining the necessity of training \& preparing associated training materials for the related Assurance personnel after release of new global scheme manual, revision of scheme manual, and key changes of the scheme requirements.

 Manage and incorporate the Schemes requirements to relevant BSI global documentation

data.jd_text:
**Position Overview** 




 InsuranceMarket.ae is the UAE’s leading insurance platform, trusted by thousands of customers and powered by a blend of technology, service excellence and deep market expertise.
 



 We are looking for a visionary and strategic
 **Director of Sales – Retail Medical Insurance** 
 to lead and expand our health insurance business. The ideal candidate will combine strategic insight, sales leadership, and a deep understanding of the UAE healthcare insurance landscape.
 



 The role will involve leveraging AI, analytics, and collaboration to create a more personalized, efficient, and scalable sales process — while ensuring top\-notch customer engagement and compliance.
 



  





 As a Renewals Manager (Individual Medical), you will serve as a strategic leader dedicated to driving retention and persistency across our retail health portfolio by working hand\-in\-hand with our existing sales teams. In this role, you will partner directly with frontline sales agents and distribution channels to champion a proactive renewal culture, equipping them with the tactical toolkits, data insights, and objection\-handling strategies needed to secure policy renewals. You will be responsible for actively monitoring sales team performance against churn targets, identifying lapse patterns, and leading targeted, sales\-driven intervention campaigns. Ultimately, your goal is to inspire and mobilize our sales forces to maximize persistency, minimize churn, and protect our recurring retail revenue.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Strategic \& Commercial Leadership** 



* Develop and implement a data\-driven sales strategy to achieve growth and profitability goals.
* Use AI\-powered insights to identify target customer segments, optimize pricing, and enhance lead prioritization.
* Collaborate with marketing and digital teams to design predictive campaigns for acquisition and retention.
* Build and scale advisory\-led sales models that deliver exceptional service quality.



**Talent Acquisition \& Development** 



* Hire, train, and mentor high\-calibre sales professionals specialized in health insurance.
* Utilize AI\-based assessments to identify talent with strong advisory and compliance acumen.
* Partner with HR and L\&D to implement AI\-enabled learning and performance analytics programs.
* Promote a culture of learning, ethics and excellence.



**Collaboration with Internal Teams** 



* Partner with Marketing to design and execute lead generation and brand awareness campaigns.
* Work closely with Technology to optimize CRM systems, digital tools, and automation for personalized sales journeys.
* Collaborate with Operations and Service teams to ensure efficient policy issuance, renewals, and claims support.
* Coordinate with Finance, Compliance, and HR to ensure alignment with organizational priorities and governance standards.



  





  





**Sales Operations \& Client Experience** 



* Use AI\-enhanced CRM tools to deliver personalized advice and track client interactions.
* Monitor sales funnel metrics, retention, and satisfaction scores using data dashboards.
* Introduce automation to streamline quotations, documentation, and renewals.



**Stakeholder Management \& Partnerships** 



* Strengthen partnerships with insurers and healthcare providers for better pricing and coverage options.
* Explore collaborations with AI\-driven healthtech and wellness platforms to enhance customer value.



**Governance \& Reporting** 



* Present performance insights and data\-backed recommendations to senior management.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, DHA regulations, and ethical sales practices.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 10–15 years of sales leadership experience in health insurance or advisory\-based businesses.
* Proven record of leading large sales teams and improving productivity through technology and collaboration.
* Deep understanding of UAE Retail Medical insurance, market dynamics, and regulatory requirements.
* Exposure to AI, CRM analytics, automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred.



  





**Key Competencies** 



* Strategic planning and commercial acumen
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration
* Talent acquisition and people development
* AI fluency and data\-driven leadership
* Customer\-focused and advisory mindset
* High integrity, adaptability, and execution excellence

Individuals in Risk Assessment \& Controls' design are responsible for developing, designing, and implementing controls programs, and providing review and guidance on robust controls design adhering to Citi’s Policies, Standards, and Frameworks. Individuals proactively identify and drive controls enhancements such as automation, standardization and rationalization including transformation execution activities. Includes first line activities for identification, measurement (significance and likelihood), and ongoing assessment of key risks and controls in partnership with relevant process owners to drive management decisions to operate within the firm’s Risk Appetite.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  

* Regulatory Change Management:
+ Actively collaborating with business to identify, evaluate, and manage regulatory adherence risks arising from the definition of business strategy, development of new products and services, changes in regulations or internal policies, or from business\-led changes.
+ Working with business, Legal \& ICRM to facilitate regulatory change management activities by performing comprehensive impact assessments of regulatory changes on existing business processes, policies, procedures, systems, data requirements, and the overall control environment. Develop and implement structured project plans for the timely and effective integration of regulatory changes across relevant business units, ensuring clear ownership and accountability.
+ Actively collaborate with business units to identify, evaluate, and manage regulatory adherence risks arising from new regulations or internal policy changes, documenting identified gaps and required actions. Facilitate communication and training programs on regulatory changes to ensure understanding and adherence by affected stakeholders across the organization. Track the implementation status of regulatory changes using established tools and methodologies, and report progress, challenges, and residual risks to senior management and governance committees. This includes maintaining an audit trail of decisions and actions taken.

* Regulatory Review \& Exam Management:
+ Serve as Controls point of contact for all regulatory examinations, audits, and inquiries from supervisory authorities, building strong working relationships.
+ Coordinate and facilitate all aspects of regulatory reviews, including meticulous information gathering, comprehensive document production, scheduling and logistical management of meetings, and managing clear and consistent communications between regulators and internal stakeholders.
+ Prepare and rigorously review responses to regulatory requests, ensuring accuracy, completeness, conciseness, and strict adherence to deadlines, often involving multiple internal stakeholders. Track, monitor, and report on all regulatory findings, recommendations, and the status of remediation efforts through their lifecycle.
+ Participate in targeted reviews and engage proactively with Internal Audit and Compliance Assurance over potential regulatory findings, contributing to a unified front.
+ Develop and implement strategies and playbooks to address recurring examination themes and enhance overall preparedness for future regulatory engagements, including mock exams and readiness assessments.

* Risk \& Control Framework and Adherence:
+ Collaborate with business units, Legal, and Independent Compliance Risk Management (ICRM) to continuously evaluate and drive the maintenance of the regulatory inventory linkage to supporting controls in Citi’s system of record. This ensures management can effectively demonstrate adherence to applicable laws and regulations through the Manager’s Control Assessment (MCA) program.
+ Support the evaluation of Regulation Risk as part of Countries’ MCA Annual Risk Assessment process.
+ Review Countries’ evaluation of Regulation Risk Control performance to identify and escalate high residual risks and those breaching defined risk appetite thresholds.
+ Contribute towards a 1st line state of regulatory adherence report for senior management, including analysis of trends, identified control gaps, and proposed corrective actions and improvements required to mitigate the identified risks.
+ Proactively support the identification of business opportunities to improve regulation risk management, prioritizing reviews to uncover root causes and unknown drivers of risk.
+ Analyze data and findings to define and present clear, concise recommendations to business leaders to strengthen their ability to make impactful strategic decisions, policy and procedure improvements, and other business strategies.
+ Work with Business, Operations \& Technology leadership and partners in 2nd and 3rd lines of defense teams to develop and implement a robust and integrated Risk and Control framework, enhance and strengthen the MCA program, and collaborate on audits, escalations, lesson learned exercises, P\&L remediation, and horizontal reviews based on emerging issues.

* Regulatory Reporting:
* Collaborate with legal, compliance, and finance teams to ensure accurate, complete, and timely submission of all required regulatory reports.
* Understand the reporting requirements stemming from new and existing regulations, translating them into actionable tasks for data collection and report generation.
* Assist in the review and validation of regulatory reports prior to submission, ensuring data integrity and adherence to reporting standards. Identify and implement process improvements for regulatory reporting to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and reduce operational risk.
* Act as a subject matter expert on reporting instructions for specific regulatory frameworks.
* Develop strong relationships with Business, Operations \& Technology leadership and partners in 2nd and 3rd lines of defense. Engage with them to reduce and mitigate regulation risk and participate in discussions pertaining to the continuous enhancement of regulation controls and monitoring.
* Engage with Regional Subject Matter Experts to develop requirements to automate controls and digitize monitoring where appropriate.
* Drive a strong culture of proactive risk management and regulatory compliance across the wealth business.


**Qualifications and Competencies:**
* Minimum of 8\-10 years of experience in regulatory change management, compliance, audit, or other control\-related functions in the financial services industry.
* Demonstrated experience with regulatory inventory management and internal control programs.
* Strong understanding of relevant financial services regulations (e.g., AML, KYC, consumer protection, data privacy, prudential regulations) is highly valued.
* Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex regulatory texts, assess their practical implications, and identify root causes of risk.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex issues clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, including senior management and regulators.
* Proven project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
* High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience with governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) tools is a plus.


**Education:** 
 Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience

 A line advisory function that coordinates with the executive management to provide added value through proper management of risks. The incumbent is also actively involved in communicating risk awareness and risk information to the management and staff of the bank.
 



  





 The area of responsibility encompasses various risks, including Credit, Market, Operational, Interest rate, Liquidity, and Asset and Liability Management.
 



  





 The job consists of managing the risk assets portfolios and the liaison between management, approving authorities, and the various Group Risk Units.
 



  





***Key Objectives:***




 Credit Risk \-
 


* Turnaround credit proposals within the stipulated time period.
* Support Group Head, Credit Risk in all credit risk matters, e.g., provide feedback on the bank credit portfolio performance, reporting requirements, etc
* Ensuring that the credit quality of the risk asset portfolio is maintained and that credit policies are kept current and in line with the strategic objectives set by the Executive Management.
* Manage periodic review processes of country limits, bank limits, large exposures, ECL computation, bond valuations, etc. as applicable for the branch
* Operational Risk \- to facilitate the Bank's Operational Risk processes, including the annual ORSA process, weekly, monthly, and quarterly management information, risk event reporting, and business continuity planning.
* Risk Management Information \- to provide management with relevant, timely, and accurate information relating to all aspects of financial risk, including credit portfolio risks, market, liquidity, and operational risks.
* Market Risk \- Review and update of market risk and ALM\-related policies. Monitoring risks as per limits set out in internal policies and statutory requirements.



  





***Principal Responsibilities***
*(list of major tasks/duties performed)* 




  




* Risk Analysis and review of credit proposals
* Track Industry trends and prepare industry reports. Analysis and recommendation
* Identify deteriorating risk profiles in consultation with Group Head, Credit Risk (corporate, industry, or market).
* Ensure that credit procedures and Higher Credit Authorities instructions are well carried out and that credit policies are kept current and in line with the strategic objectives set by the Executive Management.

By setting the vision and direction for Financial Crime Risk in the country, you will contribute significantly to the bank’s reputation and sustainability. Your leadership will foster a culture of compliance, integrity, and resilience, essential for navigating the evolving financial services sector.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to manage change effectively, supporting both transformation initiatives and operational improvements within the Financial Crime Risk (FCR) function. This includes the oversight of project delivery, policy updates, and system enhancements to strengthen controls and compliance outcomes. You will act as a resource for senior management, providing regular updates on the effectiveness of controls and potential areas of risk exposure.
   

  

 This role demands a proactive and analytical mindset, combined with excellent communication skills to articulate complex regulatory information to diverse audiences. The ability to build strong working relationships and influence decision\-making processes across the organisation will be fundamental to your success. Commitment to continuous learning and staying ahead of industry trends will enable effective leadership in this ever\-evolving field.
   

  

 Our comprehensive approach to Financial Crime Risk includes adherence to Group policies and standards, conducting compliance reviews and assurance activities, and leading investigations as necessary. You will oversee compliance risk assessments, liaise with regulators, and drive initiatives to embed compliance into everyday practices. Demonstrated capability in managing teams and projects will support delivery of change and innovation throughout the function.

 Collaborate closely with the Country Head of Financial Crime Risk (FCR) to develop, refine, and execute a comprehensive strategy that aligns with both Country and DIFC regulatory frameworks. You will play a critical role in designing and adapting operating models, ensuring robust support systems including people, processes, tools, frameworks, and technology are in place to uphold effective FCR controls.
   

  

**Regulatory Compliance and Advisory**
 Provide expert guidance to the business and compliance teams on the evolving landscape of financial crime regulations. Analyze and interpret regulatory expectations, legislation, and industry best practices to influence policies and operational decisions. Act as a key advisor for resolving conflicts between competing regulatory requirements, such as anti\-money laundering (AML) directives and data privacy laws.
   

  

**Risk Management and Communication**
 Ensure that risk frameworks and compliance standards are clearly communicated and fully understood by process owners and relevant business units. Monitor and report on regulatory changes affecting financial crime risk and advise stakeholders accordingly. Support training and awareness initiatives to embed a strong compliance culture across the organisation.
   

  

**Stakeholder Engagement**
 Work collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders, including regulators, to maintain a transparent and proactive compliance environment. Provide insights and support decision\-making processes to ensure compliance is embedded in business growth plans and operational activities.
   

  

**Skills and Experience**

Our client is a large, well\-established Saudi organization with significant scale across the Kingdom. A confidential search is underway to appoint a
 ****Chief Information Officer****
 who will own the full technology agenda and lead it as a peer to the rest of the executive team.
   

  

 This is a senior executive role with full ownership of the company's technology function. The Chief Information Officer will define and execute the technology strategy across infrastructure, enterprise applications, data, integration, and security, and will be accountable for the reliability, security, and commercial relevance of the entire technology estate.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring a clear point of view on the future state of enterprise technology, the right balance between in\-house capability and strategic partners, and the discipline to deliver value in quarters rather than years.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Duties**
* Define and execute the multi\-year technology strategy across infrastructure, applications, data, integration, and security.
* Set the target architecture for the group, including ERP, core operational systems, data and analytics, and the integration fabric that connects them.
* Make and defend the build, buy, and partner decisions that shape the technology estate.
* Run a modern, reliable enterprise systems environment that supports the core operations of the business.
* Lead any ERP modernization or migration program required to support unified reporting, real\-time decisioning, and operational scale.
* Stand up the integration and middleware capability that allows the core functions to operate from one source of truth.
* Build the data foundation, the warehouse, the governance, and the analytics layer that the commercial, operations, and finance teams need.
* Embed data\-led decision\-making across the senior leadership population.
* Hold full accountability for the cybersecurity posture of the company.
* Ensure full compliance with the National Cybersecurity Authority, the Personal Data Protection Law, and all other applicable regulatory obligations.
* Own business continuity, disaster recovery, and the controls required by internal and external audit.
* Run a service\-oriented IT operation with measurable uptime, response, and cost commitments.
* Lead the program management office for technology, with clear quarterly delivery, transparent governance, and disciplined vendor management.
* Shape the IT operating model, including the balance between in\-house capability, managed services, and strategic partners.
* Sit on the executive committee and act as a peer to the rest of the senior leadership.
* Translate technology into commercial language for the Chief Executive Officer and the board.
* Manage the technology budget with the same rigor as a P\&L, including capital allocation, vendor consolidation, and total cost of ownership.


**Requirements And Qualifications**
* Fifteen years or more in enterprise technology, with at least five at Chief Information Officer, Group CIO, or equivalent level in a complex, multi\-site organization.
* A track record of leading a full technology stack end to end, ideally in a regulated or institutionally governed environment.
* Direct, hands\-on experience with at least one major ERP transformation or core systems re\-platforming program, from business case to go\-live.
* Deep fluency in enterprise technology, including ERP platforms, integration platforms, cloud infrastructure, data and analytics, and modern security architecture.
* Strong commercial instinct, with the ability to challenge and partner with operating leaders rather than simply service them.
* Proven cybersecurity and data privacy leadership at the level expected of a major Saudi organization.
* Vendor management discipline, with a history of consolidating estates, renegotiating contracts, and holding partners to outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related discipline. Master's degree or MBA is an advantage.
* Relevant certifications in enterprise architecture, security, or program delivery are welcomed.
* Arabic language is an advantage. English is required.

**Company Description**
*We’re* 
*Checkout.com* 
*. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*
*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions daily for more than one billion global shoppers.*
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*
*If you want to do career\-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*
**The Role**
 Checkout.com is seeking a talented Senior Financial Partnerships Specialist in Riyadh to join the adventure and support our rapid growth and expansion in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 Working with a regional team, your main responsibility will be to manage and grow our partnerships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and card networks such as Visa, Mastercard and MADA. You will contribute to the development and execution of our strategy for such partnerships.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Financial Partnerships \- MENA, the successful candidate will be able to handle multiple projects and partnerships autonomously, have sufficient payments knowledge and experience to do so, and have a hands\-on approach necessary in a fast growing start\-up like ours. This is a great opportunity to contribute, learn and grow working on a broad range of projects in building a world\-class payments infrastructure.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Manage commercial relationships with Acquiring Banks, APMs and grow Card Networks (including MADA) to develop and deliver market leading payment solutions for our merchants.
* Drive expansion projects as required across geographies and payment methods in collaboration with a wider team.
* Negotiate the most favorable operational and commercial outcomes for Checkout.com while balancing internal and external stakeholders
* Ensure existing processes are followed and deliverables are met by both sides in a partnership. Design and develop new processes to scale those partnerships for growth, efficiency and performance improvement.
* Collaborate effectively with various functions in the partner organization such as relationship management, business development, risk, compliance, product and operations across all levels.
* Develop and execute a best\-in\-class partnership management model. Be the single point of contact internally and externally for assigned partnerships.
* Use payments industry knowledge and experience to develop and execute strategies to support our growth with new products, services and market segments through partnerships.
* Craft and implement win\-win commercial agreements and go\-to\-market strategies with payment partners.
* Leverage knowledge about the payments industry and partners’ capabilities to act as subject matter experts for internal teams.


**Qualifications**
* At least 3 years experience in payments.
* Direct experience in payment processing, acquiring, or managing payment partnerships.
* Proficient in payments knowledge, with the ability to problem solve or identify potential blockers within the payment flow and communicate these problems effectively to the wider teams.
* Experience working with card networks or PSPs for acquiring payment transactions is a strong plus.
* A mix of operations, project management, and relationship management skill set.
* A strong sense of ownership to deliver business results with a focus on managing partner relationships.
* Arabic speaking is MANDATORY for this role due to the relationships with local partners
* Strong collaborator and communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders across organizations internally and externally.
* Data\-driven, analytical and strategic in problem solving issues and identifying opportunities to drive growth and efficiency.
* Comfortable working across time zones and cultures in a globally distributed team.


**Additional Information**
**Bring all of you to work**
 We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
   

  

 Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
   

  

 We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
   

  

 It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
   

  

**Life at** 
**Checkout.com**
 We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.
   

  

 Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
 The SAP Payment \& Cash Management Expert is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting end\-to\-end payment processing and liquidity management solutions in SAP. This includes the setup of electronic payment workflows, bank integrations, cash positioning, and liquidity forecasting, with a focus on automation, compliance, and visibility into cash operations.
   

  

 The Expert will work closely with treasury, finance, AP, and banking partners to streamline global payment processes, enforce banking standards, and ensure full compliance with local and international regulations. Experience in S/4HANA, BCM, In\-House Cash, and SWIFT/ISO\-based formats is essential.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and configuration of SAP Payment \& Cash Management solutions
* Set up house banks, bank accounts, signatory workflows, and approval hierarchies
* Implement and manage SAP BCM workflows for multi\-level payment approvals
* Design and generate payment files in compliance with local/international banking formats
* Configure electronic bank statement (EBS) processing and reconciliation logic
* Support cash flow analysis, cash positioning, and liquidity forecasting in SAP
* Coordinate with banks for technical specs, testing, and go\-live of bank interfaces
* Ensure security, compliance, and audit readiness of payment workflows
* Align SAP payment processes with finance and treasury policies
* Document configurations, support training, and handle post\-go\-live support


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Information Systems
* SAP Certified Application Associate – Treasury or Cash Management (preferred)
* Project Management certification (PMP or equivalent) preferred
* Certification in treasury management (CTP, CFA) is a plus


**Experience**
* 8–12 years of SAP experience in Payments and Cash Management
* At least 2 years in a team leadership or Expertial role
* Proven experience with SAP BCM, EBS, Cash Management, and bank integrations
* Project exposure in S/4HANA Cash Management, Multi\-Bank Connectivity, or TRM
* At least 5 years of experience in the banking sector


**Technical \& Functional Skills**
* Strong configuration experience in:
* Bank Master, House Bank, Bank Account Management (BAM)
* Payment Media Workbench and Format Mapping (DMEE, Payment Formats)
* Cash Positioning and Liquidity Forecast Setup
* Understanding of SWIFT, ISO 20022, SEPA, and local banking regulations
* Integration experience with FI\-AP, Treasury, and external banking systems
* Familiarity with SAP In\-House Cash, Payment Factory setups, or MBC
* Knowledge of SAP FIORI apps for Bank Account and Payment Management


**Soft Skills**
* Strong financial acumen with a process\-driven mindset
* Effective communication with finance, treasury, and banking stakeholders
* Ability to manage global rollouts and banking compliance requirements
* Detail\-oriented with strong documentation, testing, and governance focus
* Team leadership, cross\-functional coordination, and stakeholder alignment

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

**Description**
 We are looking for a Program Management Executive (Implementations) with strong technical operations skills to support Tabby’s merchant and channel partner ecosystem.  You will play a key role in technical onboarding, operational coordination, and product rollout execution. Your work ensures that merchants implement Tabby in the most optimal way and deliver a seamless payment experience across all touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a fast\-paced role that requires someone who is detail\-oriented, proactive, and comfortable navigating both technical concepts and business conversations.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving operational challenges, improving processes, and working across multiple teams to deliver merchant success at scale — this role is for you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Serve as the primary operational and technical liaison between Tabby and partner merchants, coordinating closely with Risk, Integrations, BD, and Key Account teams.

* Manage merchant data\-enablement workflows, ensuring required data is captured, validated, and aligned with risk and underwriting requirements.
* Lead and manage negotiations with merchants about technical requirements, ensuring they understand Tabby’s data, integration, and compliance needs while balancing business objectives.
* Coordinate cross\-functional alignment on product rollouts by preparing merchant\-facing materials, supporting GTM plans, and ensuring seamless execution across teams.
* Analyze merchant performance and integration health, identify operational gaps, and propose improvements to enhance the merchant experience.

 Solid analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data patterns and identify issues in merchant integrations or data quality.
   

 Excellent cross\-functional communication — able to translate technical concepts into actionable steps for non\-technical stakeholders.
   

 Experience managing negotiations with merchants about technical or data requirements, balancing business needs with technical feasibility.
   

 Strong documentation skills with the ability to build processes, SOPs, and clear merchant\-facing guides.

 Background supporting enterprise merchants and managing negotiation discussions.

**About Us**
 Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer\-centric financial super\-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in KSA, UAE and Kuwait, and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, Amazon, IKEA, eXtra and Farfetch as well as small and medium businesses.
   

  

 Tamara is Saudi’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others, operating out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia with other regional and global support offices.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a startup\-within\-a\-startup role. You will be responsible for building a net new banking product from scratch for the Saudi Arabia market — from ideation through design and launch.
   

  

 This role is high ambiguity, high complexity, and requires someone who thrives in uncharted territory. There is no playbook — you will write it. You must be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making tactical trade\-offs, and moving with execution velocity.
   

  

 As Product Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle of a new fintech product that will advance how merchants at Tamara manage their money. You will work daily with a full\-stack team — engineers, product designers, researchers, data analysts, operations, and business stakeholders — to ship an innovative and incredible experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the execution, vision \& strategy for a net new fintech vertical.
* Work with engineers, designers, data scientists, and commercial teams to drive the roadmap for a net\-new product.
* Be technically competent enough to be able to decide on the execution plan while managing several internal technical dependencies.
* Deeply understand the KSA Fintech ecosystem, compliance rules \& regulations — and understand how it may impact your roadmap.
* Deeply understand the operational impacts of the products we are releasing \& work with risk, compliance, treasury, customer support and others to ensure product success.
* Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor, Claude \& Codex to accelerate product development work.
* Contribute to commercial planning \& GTM of the product and own the outcomes.
* Lead a core team of engineers \& designers and drive the end to end execution forward.
* Contribute to the evolution of Tamara’s Product Management practices as AI scales our work.


**Qualifications**
* You have 4\+ years of Product Management experience, with proven experience building 0—\>1 products that have shipped and scaled.
* You have worked with early stage product teams or startups and have successfully taken a product from concept to launch.
* You have strong UX taste — you care deeply about the end\-to\-end customer experience and can hold a high bar for product quality.
* You have experience working on complex, multi\-surface products with a large blast radius of impact.
* You are a strong collaborator who works effectively with engineering, design, data, and operations teams on a daily basis.
* You are data\-driven — you have strong analytical skills, are comfortable with experimentation, and can use data to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
* You are able to think from first principles, break down complex problems, and navigate ambiguity with confidence.
* You have strong business acumen — you understand unit economics, business models, and can make decisions that balance customer value with business outcomes.
* You understand regulatory requirements and operational considerations that come with building financial products.
* You are customer\-obsessed — you aren’t shy about getting on calls with merchants, visiting them, and deeply understanding their needs.
* FinTech experience — you have worked on financial products before and understand the nuances of payments, banking, lending, or adjacent spaces.
* Must have the ability to use AI in their day to day to work. Preferred experience working in high\-growth companies.
* Arabic speaking is required for this role — you will work closely with merchants and stakeholders in KSA.


 All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

data.jd_text:
**About The Company**
 At Flow, we’re reimagining what it means to live, work, and connect. More than just a real estate company, Flow is a brand, a technology platform, and an operations ecosystem spanning condominiums, hotels, multifamily residences, and office spaces. We’re building a new kind of living experience: one that’s flexible, connected, and designed to create genuine community and real value for the people who call Flow home.
   

  

 Our mission is oneness: prioritizing our residents and their experiences, and fostering connection with ourselves, their neighbors, and the natural world. By putting people at the center of everything we do, we’re creating vibrant, human\-centered communities where life, work, creativity, and play all come together in one place.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Head of Operations, Saudi Arabia, you will lead the operational performance of Flow’s portfolio across the Kingdom, with direct oversight of General Managers and property leadership teams. You will be responsible for building and scaling the operational foundation of the business — ensuring exceptional resident experience, strong hospitality standards, operational consistency, and scalable processes across all properties.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role for someone with a strong hospitality and property management background who understands how to build systems, processes, and teams in a fast\-scaling environment. You will play a critical role in defining how Flow operates in Saudi Arabia and in building the operational playbook that supports long\-term growth.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Operational Leadership**
* Lead and manage General Managers across the Saudi portfolio, ensuring strong execution, accountability, and operational consistency.
* Drive operational excellence across all properties, including resident experience, maintenance, housekeeping, security, amenities, and hospitality services.
* Establish clear operational standards and ensure consistent execution across all communities.
* Conduct regular property reviews and operational audits to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Build a culture of operational discipline, service excellence, and attention to detail.


**Process Building \& Scalability**
* Design, implement, and continuously improve operational SOPs, workflows, and service standards across the business.
* Build scalable operational systems that support rapid portfolio growth while maintaining quality and consistency.
* Create operational playbooks for property openings, staffing, training, maintenance, resident experience, and escalation management.
* Standardize reporting structures, KPIs, operational reviews, and accountability frameworks.
* Partner closely with product, development, and technology teams to improve operational tools and infrastructure.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and implement process improvements across the portfolio.


**Property \& Hospitality Operations**
* Oversee day\-to\-day property operations with a strong focus on hospitality, service culture, and resident satisfaction.
* Ensure all properties consistently deliver a premium hospitality\-driven living experience.
* Partner closely with facilities, maintenance, and development teams to ensure assets are maintained to the highest standards.
* Drive operational readiness for new property launches, including staffing, systems, training, and service delivery.
* Help define and evolve brand standards for hospitality, presentation, and operational quality.


**Financial \& Performance Management**
* Own operational KPIs across the portfolio including occupancy, resident satisfaction, retention, service levels, and property performance.
* Partner with finance and commercial teams on budgeting, forecasting, and operational cost management.
* Develop dashboards and reporting mechanisms to monitor operational health and performance trends.
* Drive operational efficiencies while maintaining premium resident experience and service quality.


**Leadership \& Team Development**
* Recruit, mentor, and develop high\-performing property leadership teams.
* Create clear accountability structures and performance expectations across operations.
* Foster a strong hospitality\-led culture focused on professionalism, execution, and resident experience.
* Partner closely with country and global leadership teams to align operational strategy with company goals.


 Ideal Background
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in hospitality, residential operations, property management, or operational leadership roles.
* Strong experience managing multi\-site operations and leading senior property teams.
* Proven experience building operational systems, SOPs, and scalable processes in a growing organization.
* Hospitality background strongly preferred, particularly within premium residential, hotel, branded residence, or lifestyle hospitality environments.
* Deep understanding of operational excellence, resident experience, and service standards.
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability and operational rigor.
* Experience operating within Saudi Arabia or the GCC strongly preferred.
* Arabic fluency is a plus.
* Builder mindset with comfort operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**Why Join Flow?**
**Exciting growth opportunity:** 
 Be part of a fast\-growing company shaping the future of residential living in the Middle East.
   

  

**Competitive Compensation \& Benefits.**
**A chance to make an impact:** 
 Help build a vibrant international community and redefine what it means to call Flow home.
   

  

 If you have the energy, talent, and work ethic to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you! Apply now and be part of Flow’s success story!

A large\-scale global Saudi operating group is appointing a Chief Executive Officer to lead the next phase of operational scale, execution maturity, and commercial performance across a nationally distributed business.
   

  

 The organisation operates across multiple service and infrastructure\-related verticals with a significant workforce footprint, complex field operations, and active transformation initiatives already underway.
   

  

 This is a high\-accountability operating role with direct ownership of performance, leadership cadence, execution quality, and long\-term organisational positioning.
   

  

 The mandate
   

  

 The incoming CEO will oversee:
   

  

* Multi\-site operations and customer delivery performance
* Commercial growth and operating economics
* Workforce and leadership alignment across a distributed organisation
* Ongoing transformation and operational\-modernisation initiatives
* Executive governance and board engagement
* Strategic partnerships and long\-term operating scalability


 The board is seeking a commercially mature operator who can balance disciplined execution with sustainable growth in a rapidly evolving Saudi market environment.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Minimum of 18 years of experience in large\-scale operating environments
* At least 5 years in senior leadership positions such as CEO, COO, Country Head, or leading significant business units
* Demonstrated accountability for Profit and Loss within operationally intensive organizations
* Proven experience in managing extensive workforce populations and distributed operational models
* Exemplary executive presence when engaging with boards, shareholders, or governance entities
* Experience operating within Saudi Arabia, the GCC, Africa, and globally is highly preferred
* Fluency in both Arabic and English is desirable


**Particular interest in leaders who have:**
* Led operational transformation at scale
* Managed customer\-facing service or infrastructure\-heavy businesses
* Built strong executive teams and succession depth
* Stabilised performance while maintaining growth momentum
* Operated effectively in founder\-led, family\-owned, shareholder\-led, or institutional environments


**This role is not suited to:**
* Pure advisory or consulting profiles without major operating accountability
* Executives without meaningful large\-scale operational leadership exposure
* Leaders whose experience has been primarily limited to matrix\-reporting corporate structures without full ownership responsibility


**Benefits**
 Structured to attract top\-tier executive leadership currently operating at significant scale within Saudi Arabia and the GCC, including performance\-linked incentives and long\-term alignment mechanisms.

**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Visa Consulting Manager will be a key member of the VCA organization in MENA and will contribute to the commercial traction, product development and thought leadership across practice areas. The role will also deliver subject matter expertise and consulting support to VISA's key clients across clusters. The main objective of the role is to help deepen client relationships and optimize client performance by helping them design and assess their payments strategy and implement initiatives to capture the full potential from enhancing customers engagement.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities/Key Results Area**
* Collaborate with VCA colleagues, Visa account executives and other Visa functions to cultivate and manage a pipeline of engagement opportunities with the largest banks and merchants in the region
* Lead and/or serve as a subject matter expert on consulting engagements across practice areas (portfolio, digital, risk) including but not limited to the following,
+ Using VISA and external data to analyze client needs across the focus markets and identify opportunities for consulting assignments with VISA’s key clients
+ Support and contribute to sales pitches
+ Lead or contribute to internal problem\-solving sessions
+ Prepare for, and participate in, client discussions
+ Be involved in project deliveries in both coordination and delivery role
+ Work closely with other VISA groups, including Products, Business Development, Risk, Marketing, Digital Solutions, Digital Partnerships \& Ventures, Innovation Center etc., to ensure a seamless Consulting experience
+ Contribute to the development, when needed, of practice areas in terms of product development


**Key Competencies**
* A well\-qualified candidate will have broad and deep expertise in Payments Consulting across multiple areas of focus. Key elements to assess his/her candidacy will include expertise on the following topics,
* Business needs of issuers, acquirers and merchants in Portfolio, Digital, and Risk e.g., strategy, acquisition, customers and channels full potential, innovation, mobile platforms, digital ecosystems, authorization etc.

* Industry trends, such as evolving economics of payments, new customer value propositions, increasing digitalization and development of digital channels, increasing use of advanced analytics and other technologies in payments and targeting, changing regulatory environment, etc.


 This is a hybrid position. Hybrid employees can alternate time between both remote and office. * Deep consulting skills and client engagement capabilities. Advanced client management and presentation skills. Credibility with clients and working teams and diplomatic skills to extract desired outcomes. Comfortable interacting with and presenting to senior management of clients and VISA.

* Superior project management skills. Fluent communicator.
* Results driven, flexible and both internally and externally customer focused.
* Able to travel frequently and work on client site for extended periods across MENA.
* Self\-motivated and able to use own initiative with limited direction.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with inter\-disciplinary groups.
* Ability to work in a multi\-cultural environment.
* Fluency in English mandatory. Arabic desired but not a prerequisite


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
